**Drops**: 1x [](item://minecraft:skeleton_skull)
Possessed Skeleton

The Wild Strong Breeze is 'Flow-Forged', granting a powerful version of the regular Breeze. This is the final target to obtain a [](item://minecraft:heavy_core) and as a bonus, you can get: [](item://minecraft:flow_armor_trim_smithing_template), [](item://minecraft:flow_banner_pattern), [](item://minecraft:flow_pottery_sherd) and [](item://minecraft:music_disc_creator).
**Drops**: 1x [](item://minecraft:heavy_core) and can drop other things (See next page);
Glorious Vault
See [Drikwing Familiar](entry://familiar_rituals/familiar_otherworld_bird) for more information.
**Provides**: A tameable Drikwing
Unbound Drikwing

In this ritual a [#](ad03fc)Foliot[#]() is summoned **as an untamed spirit**.
\
\
The slaughter of a [#](ad03fc)Chicken[#]() and the offering of dyes are intended to entice the Foliot to take the shape of a parrot. As [#](ad03fc)Foliot[#]() are not among the smartest spirits, they sometimes misunderstand the instructions ...
*This means, if a [#](ad03fc)Chicken[#]() is spawned, that's not a bug, just bad luck!*
**Provides**: A tameable Parrot
Unbound Parrot

In this ritual a [#](ad03fc)Warden[#]() is spawned using the life energy of a [#](ad03fc)Axolotl[#]() and immediately possessed by the summoned [#](ad03fc)Afrit[#](). The [#](ad03fc)Possessed Warden[#]() will always drop at least six [](item://minecraft:echo_shard) when killed and as a chance to drop [](item://minecraft:disc_fragment_5), [](item://minecraft:music_disc_otherside), [](item://minecraft:silence_armor_trim_smithing_template), [](item://minecraft:ward_armor_trim_smithing_template). If you try to escape, this possessed Warden will go to the floor like a normal warden.

**Drops**: 6-9x [](item://minecraft:echo_shard)
and items related to ancient city;
Possessed Warden

[](item://minecraft:breeze_rod) cannot be obtained from Wild Weak Breeze rods due to their fragile nature, but this version of Breeze hides some treasures and has a chance to drop: [](item://minecraft:guster_pottery_sherd), [](item://minecraft:scrape_pottery_sherd), [](item://minecraft:music_disc_creator_music_box) and [](item://minecraft:ominous_bottle).
**Drops**: 1x [](item://minecraft:trial_key) and can drop other things (See next page);
The first key

In this ritual a [#](ad03fc)Shulker[#]() is spawned using the life energy of a [#](ad03fc)Cube Mob[#]() and immediately possessed by the summoned [#](ad03fc)Djinni[#](). The [#](ad03fc)Possessed Weak Shulker[#]() will always drop at least one [](item://minecraft:chorus_fruit) when killed and as a chance to drop [](item://minecraft:shulker_shell). You can use vanilla shulker multiplication to get normal shulkers with more chance to drop their shells.

**Drops**: 1-3x [](item://minecraft:chorus_fruit)
and as 10%% to drop a [](item://minecraft:shulker_shell);
Possessed Weak Shulker

In this ritual a [#](ad03fc)Witch[#]() is spawned using the rage energy from the [#](ad03fc)Cat[#]() death. The [#](ad03fc)Possessed Witch[#]() can drop a [](item://minecraft:experience_bottle), [](item://minecraft:honey_bottle), [](item://minecraft:ominous_bottle) or a simple water bottle.
**Drops**: Can drop: [](item://minecraft:experience_bottle) or other bottles (See next page);
Possessed Witch

In this ritual an [#](ad03fc)afrit[#]() will possess an [#](ad03fc)Old Zombified Piglin[#](),
 unifying the energies of the [#](ad03fc)nether[#](), the power of the [#](ad03fc)afrit[#](),
  the material [#](ad03fc)pork[#]() and the concept of the color [#](ad03fc)pink[#]().
 This is the only known method to obtain [](item://occultism:demonic_meat), its properties
  prevent cooking but grant fire resistance to whoever consumes it.

**Drops**: 1-4x [](item://occultism:demonic_meat) and
  other body parts;
Possessed Zombified Piglin
Return to Rituals Category

You have learned how to attract groups of random animals by changing
 the pentacle to [#](ad03fc)Osorin's Wild Calling[#]() and using a
 [](item://occultism:spirit_attuned_gem) instead of a bound book of binding.
Summon Group of Random Animal
Group of Random Animal

Besides venturing into nether dungeons, there is one more way to get these skulls. The legendary [#](ad03fc)Wild Hunt[#]() consists of [#](ad03fc)Greater Spirits[#]() taking the form of wither skeletons. While summoning the Wild Hunt is incredibly dangerous, it is the fastest way to get wither skeleton skulls.
Wither Skeleton Skull
Wild Hunt
book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.rit:
Some rituals require the use of certain items to be performed. Use the item described on the ritual's page within **16 blocks** of the [](item://occultism:golden_sacrificial_bowl) to proceed with the ritual.
\
\
**Important:** Before using the item, start the ritual. Grey particles indicate that the ritual is ready for the item use.

If a ritual shows grey particles above the golden ritual bowl, then additional requirements as described in the ritual's page need to be fulfilled. Once all requirements are fulfilled, the ritual will show purple particles and start to consume the items in the sacrificial bowls.

Rituals allow to summon spirits into our plane of existence, or bind them into objects or living beings. Every ritual consists of a [#](ad03fc)Pentacle[#](), [#](ad03fc)Ritual Ingredients[#]() provided via sacrificial bowls, a [#](ad03fc)Starting Item[#]() and optionally the [#](ad03fc)Sacrifice[#]() of living beings. A purple particle effect will show that the ritual is successful and in progress.

Rituals always follow the same steps:
- Draw the pentacle.
- Place a golden ritual bowl.
- Place sacrificial bowls.
- Put ingredients in bowls.
- [#](ad03fc)Right-click[#]()the golden bowl with the activation item.
- *Optional: Perform a sacrifice close to the center of the pentacle.*

Some rituals require the sacrifice of a living being to provide the necessary energy to summon the spirit. Sacrifices are described on the ritual's page under the "Sacrifice" subheading. To perform a sacrifice, kill an animal within 8 blocks of the golden ritual bowl. Only kills by players count as sacrifice!
book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.spi: Only trader, time and weather spirits are affected by essence decay, by default. All others are immune and will not despawn. Modpacks may modify this behaviour.

The summoner can slow or even stop essence decay by binding the spirit into an object, or summoning it into a living being. Additionally the pentacle used can influence the effects of essence decay to a degree.
Even the immortal are not immune to time.

When residing in our plane of existence, spirits experience [#](ad03fc)Essence Decay[#](), the slow rot of their "body". The more powerful the spirit, the slower the decay, but only the most powerful can stop it entirely. Once fully decayed they are returned to [#](ad03fc)The Other Place[#]() and can only be re-summoned once fully recovered.
Even more powerful than Djinni, Afrit are used for the creation of major artifacts and the possession of powerful beings.

The most commonly summoned class. There is a great variety of Djinni, differing both in intelligence and power. Djinni can be used for a variety of task, ranging from higher artifacts over possession of living beings to carrying out tasks in their Chosen Form.
The lowest identified class of spirit. Equipped with some intelligence and a modicum of power they are most often used for manual labor or minor artifacts.
Spirits of power so great it is beyond measure. No summons have been attempted in living memory, and records of summonings in ancient times are mostly considered apocryphal.

[#](ad03fc)Spirit[#](), commonly referred to also as [#](ad03fc)Demon[#](), is a general term for a variety of supernatural entities usually residing in [#](ad03fc)The Other Place[#](), a plane of existence entirely separate from our own.

The strongest identified class of spirits. Due to their power and vast intellect attempting a summoning is extremely dangerous and usually only carried out by the most experienced summoners, and even then usually in groups.
When in our world Spirits can take a variety of forms, by morphing their essence into [#](ad03fc)Chosen Forms[#](). Alternatively, they can inhabit objects or even living beings.

There are four major "ranks" of spirits identified by researchers, but there are a myriad spirits below and in between these ranks, and some great entities of terrible power, referred to only as [#](ad03fc)Greater Spirits[#](), that are beyond classification.

In ancient summoners had to research and experiment to find [#](ad03fc)True Names[#](). Some spirits can be convinced to share their knowledge of true names of other demons, either by promising a swift return to [#](ad03fc)The Other Place[#](), or by more ... *persuasive* measures.

To summon a spirit the magician needs to know their [#](ad03fc)True Name[#](). By calling the true naming during the summoning ritual the Spirit is drawn forth from [#](ad03fc)The Other Place[#]() and forced to do the summoners bidding.
\
\
*It should be noted, that it does not matter which spirit name is used in summoning, only the spirit tier is relevant.*

For your convenience, in this work you will find the known names of spirits of all 4 ranks, as well as some beyond that. To summon a spirit, copy their name from this book into the appropriate book of binding, then use this bound book of binding to activate a ritual.
Using Names to Summon a Spirit
Try not to lose your spirits!

Unbound summonings are the only way to obtain [Afrit Essence](entry://summoning_rituals/afrit_essence), a powerful substance required for crafting [](item://occultism:chalk_red) which is used for the most powerful binding pentacles.

Generally spirits are summoned [#](ad03fc)bound[#](), which refers to any condition that keeps them under control of the summoner. A side effect of binding spells is that part of the spirit remains in [#](ad03fc)The Other Place[#](), robbing them of large portions of the power, but at the same time also protecting their essence from foreign access in this world.

In order to access a spirit's essence, or unleash it's full destructive power, it needs to be summoned [#](ad03fc)unbound[#](). Unbound summonings use pentacles that are intentionally incomplete or unstable, allowing to call on the spirit, but not putting any constraints on it.

The lack of restraints when summoning spirits unbound makes these rituals incredibly dangerous, but you may find that the rewards are worth the risk - and often there is no way around them to achieve certain results.
You better watch out, you better not cry ...

A group of legendary Greater Spirits, usually appearing in the form of wither skeletons, with their skeleton minions. The Greater Spirits are bound to their minions in such fashion that they are virtually invulnerable until their minions have been sent back to [#](ad03fc)The Other Place[#]().

While it is incredibly dangerous to call on the Wild Hunt, some summoners have been known to do so for quick access to the rare wither skeleton skulls they are known to leave behind. Summoning the wild hunt is described in detail on the page on obtaining [Wither Skeleton Skulls](entry://possession_rituals/wither_skull).
book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.sto:
Forging the [](item://occultism:storage_controller_stabilized) is one service provide by [#](AA00AA)Eldritch Spirits[#](),
 this block will helps occult masters twist space, placing the stabilizers in the same
 position as the actuator in some extra-planar dimension invisible even to the best eyes.\
 By default this item receives two bonus stabilizer tier 5\
 Other external stabilizers do not affect this block.\
 The recipe keep items inside!

This simple storage stabilizer is inhabited by a [#](AA00AA)Foliot[#]() that supports the dimensional matrix
 in keeping the storage dimension stable, thus allowing to store more items.
\
\
By default each Tier 1 Stabilizer adds **64** item types and 512000 items storage capacity.

This improved stabilizer is inhabited by a [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]() that supports the dimensional matrix
 in keeping the storage dimension stable, thus allowing to store more items.
\
\
By default each Tier 2 Stabilizer adds **128** item types and 1024000 items storage capacity.

This advanced stabilizer is inhabited by a [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#]() that supports the dimensional matrix
 in keeping the storage dimension stable, thus allowing to store more items.
\
\
By default each Tier 3 Stabilizer adds **256** item types and 2048000 items storage capacity.

This highly advanced storage stabilizer is inhabited by a [#](AA00AA)Marid[#]() that supports the dimensional matrix
 in keeping the storage dimension stable, thus allowing to store more items.
\
\
By default each Tier 4 Stabilizer adds **512** item types and 4098000 items storage capacity.

The stable wormhole allows access to a dimensional matrix from a remote destination.
\
\
Shift-click a [](item://occultism:storage_controller) to link it, then place the wormhole in the world to use it as a remote access point.

The [](item://occultism:storage_remote) can be linked to a [](item://occultism:storage_controller) by shift-clicking.
 The [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]() bound to the accessor will then be able to
 access items from the actuator even from across dimensions.

Every summoner knows the problem: There are just too many occult paraphernalia lying around.
 The solution is simple, yet elegant: Magic Storage!
\
\
Using Spirits able to access storage dimensions it is possible to create almost unlimited storage space.

Follow the steps shown in this category to get your own storage system!
 The steps related to storage in [Binding Rituals](category://crafting_rituals) show only the rituals,
 while here **all required steps** including crafting are shown.

This extremely advanced stabilizer maybe is inhabited by a [#](AA00AA)Ancient Spirit[#]() that supports
 the dimensional matrix in keeping the storage dimension stable, thus allowing to store even more items.
\
\
By default each Tier 5 Stabilizer adds **1024** item types and 8196000 items storage capacity.

This is the actual block that works as a storage, make sure to craft it!
 Placing just the [](item://occultism:storage_controller_base) from the previous step wont work.

The item type amount and storage size can be configured in the
 "[#](AA00AA)occultism-server.toml[#]()" config file in the save directory of your world.

The [](item://occultism:storage_controller) consists of a [Dimensional Matrix](entry://crafting_rituals/craft_dimensional_matrix) inhabited by a [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]() that creates and manages a storage dimension,
 and a [Base](entry://crafting_rituals/craft_storage_controller_base) infused with a [#](AA00AA)Foliot[#]() that moves items in and out of the storage dimension.

For other mods the storage controller behaves like a shulker box, anything that can
 interact with vanilla chests and shulker boxes can interact with the storage controller.
 Devices that count storage contents may have trouble with the stack sizes.

Breaking the storage controller will store all contained items in the dropped item, you will not lose anything.
 The same applies to breaking or replacing Storage Stabilizers (you will learn about these later).
 \
 \
 Like in a shulker box, your items are safe!

The storage controller holds up to **128** different types of items
 (_You will learn later how to increase that_). Additionally it is limited to 256000 items in total.
 It does not matter if you have 256000 different items or 256000 of one item, or any mix.

Items with unique properties ("NBT data"), such as damaged or enchanted equipment will take up
 one item type for each variation. For example two wooden swords with two different damage values
 take up two item types. Two wooden swords with the same (or no) damage take up one item type.

After crafting the [](item://occultism:storage_controller) (see following pages), place it in the world and [#](55FF55)right-click[#]() it with an empty hand.
 This will open the GUI of the storage controller, from there on it will work much like a very big [](item://minecraft:shulker_box).

Storage controllers need to point at the [Dimensional Matrix](entry://crafting_rituals/craft_dimensional_matrix), that means **one block above the [Storage Actuator](entry://storage/storage_controller)**.
 \
 \
 They can be **up to 5 blocks away** from the Dimensional Matrix, and need to be in
 a straight line of sight. See the next page for a possible very simple setup.

The stabilizer system works by tier, starting from 0 (which does not add space) up to 5.
\
\
To get started, see the recipes and instructions on the following pages.

**Note:** You do not need all 4 stabilizers, even one will increase your storage.
 In addition, the up and down directions also work.

Storage Stabilizers increase the storage space in the storage dimension of the storage actuator.
 The higher the tier of the stabilizer, the more additional storage it provides.
 The following entries will show you how to craft each tier.

It is **safe to destroy a storage stabilizer** to upgrade it. The items
 in the [Storage Actuator](entry://storage/storage_controller) will not be lost or dropped - you simply cannot add new items
 until you add enough storage stabilizers to have free slots again.
Inserting and extracting items from the Storage Actuator

Extracting items can lead to performance issues, especially when pipes with Item Filters
 are used, because then the entire huge storage is searched for these items one by one.
 \
 \
 To *massively* improve performance, use Transporter Spirits to extract from the
 Storage Actuator or Stable Wormhole. Even if the Spirit deposits into a chest
 right next to the storage system, and a pipe extracts from that chest, the
 performance is **much** better than if a pipe extracts directly.

When inserting items, you do not need to do anything, the Storage Actuator will
 maximize performance automatically for you. It is safe to insert high amounts
 of items at high frequencies without negative impact on game performance.

The Storage Actuator behaves much like a big chest or shulker box.
 That means, hoppers and pipes can insert and extract items.

Due to the potentially huge amount of items in the storage system,
 it is good to consider some performance aspects, otherwise your
 system might slow down your game or even a server you are playing on.
Inserting and extracting items from the Storage Actuator using Theurgy Logistics

Once again, item extraction is the critical issue for performance.
\
\
To make use of the performance optimization, use a [](item://theurgy:logistics_item_extractor)
 and apply a [](item://theurgy:list_filter) to extract the desired items.
\
\
The Theurgy Guidebook "The Hermetica" has a chapter on Theurgy
 mercurial logistics and how to use them to insert and extract items.

Much like transporter Spirits, Theurgy Mercurial Logistics systems
 are optimized to work with the Storage Actuator and Stable Wormholes.

If you lose the book of calling, you can craft a new one.
[#](55FF55)Shift-right-click[#]() the spirit with the crafted book to assign it.

The machine operator transfers items specified in the dimensional
 storage actuator GUI, to it's managed machine, and returns crafting
 results to the storage system. It can also be used to automatically
 empty a chest into the storage actuator.
 \
 Basically, on-demand crafting!

To use the machine operator use the book of calling to link a Storage
  Actuator, the machine and optionally a separate extract location
  (the face you click on will be extracted from!). For the machine
  you can additionally set a custom name and the insert/extract facings.

Please note that setting a new machine (or configuring it with
 the book of calling) will reset the extraction settings.
 \
 \
 For an easy start, make sure to view the short
 [Tutorial Video](https://gyazo.com/237227ba3775e143463b31bdb1b06f50)!

Use the book of calling to set the actuator, managed machine and extract locations of the machine operator.
 \
 \
 See [Books of Calling](entry://getting_started/books_of_calling) for more information.
book.occultism.dictionary_of_spirits.sum:
[](item://occultism:afrit_essence) is required to safely call on the more powerful spirits, commonly used
 in the form of red chalk. To obtain the essence, an [#](AA00AA)Afrit[#]() needs to be summoned
 unbound into this plane, and killed. Be warned that this is no simple endeavour,
 and unbound spirit presents great danger to all nearby.

[](item://occultism:marid_essence)  is required to safely control the most powerful spirits, commonly used
 in the form of blue chalk. To obtain the essence, an [#](AA00AA)Marid[#]() needs to be summoned
 unbound into this plane, and killed. Be warned that this is no simple endeavour,
 and unbound spirit presents great danger to all nearby.

Summon rituals force spirits to enter this world in their chosen shape, leading
 to little restrictions on their power. Summoned spirits range from trade spirits
 that trade and convert items, to slave-like helpers for manual labour.

If you lose the book of calling, you can craft a new one.
[#](55FF55)Shift-right-click[#]() the spirit with the crafted book to assign it.

The janitor will pick up dropped items and deposit them into a target
inventory. You can configure an allow/block list to specify which
items to pick up or ignore. **Warning**: By default it is set to
"allow" mode, so it will only pick up items you specify in the
allow list. You can use tags to handle whole groups of items.

To bind the janitor to an inventory simply sneak and interact
with the janitor book of calling on that inventory. You can
also interact with a block while holding the janitor book of
calling to have it deposit items there. You can also have it
wander around a select area by pulling up that interface.
To configure an allow/block list sneak and interact with the janitor.

The Janitor will pick up crushed items from a [Crusher](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_crusher_t1), [Smelter](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_smelter_t1), [Crystallizer](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_crystallizer_t1)
spirits and deposit them into a chest.
\
\
Combine that with a [Transporter Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items) to automate the whole process.

Use the book of calling to set the work area and deposit location of the janitor.
 \
 \
 See [Books of Calling](entry://getting_started/books_of_calling) for more information.

Crusher spirits are summoned to crush ores into dusts, effectively multiplying the metal output.
   They will pick up appropriate ores and drop the resulting dusts into the world.
   A spark particle effect and a crushing sound indicate the crusher is at work.

To ease automation, try summoning a [Transporter Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items) to place items from chests
 in the crusher's inventory, and a [Janitor Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_cleaner) to collect the processed items.

The foliot crusher is the most basic crusher spirit.
 \
 \
 It will crush **one** ore into **two** corresponding dusts.

The djinni crusher is faster, more efficient and proficient than the foliot crusher.
Allowing ice to be crushed without melting.
\
It will crush **one** ore into **three** corresponding dusts.

The afrit crusher is faster and more efficient than the djinni crusher.
\
\
It will crush **one** ore into **four** corresponding dusts.

The marid crusher is faster, more efficient and proficient than the afrit crusher.
Allowing crushing the echo shard while maintaining its properties.
\
It will crush **one** ore into **six** corresponding dusts.

Crystallizer spirits are summoned to regenerate gem from their dusts and directly multiply
the output of breaking gem ores. They will pick up appropriate items and drop the resulting into
the world. A magical particle effect and a amethyst sound indicate the crystallizer is at work.

To ease automation, try summoning a [Transporter Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items) to place items from chests in the
 crystallizer's inventory, and a [Janitor Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_cleaner) to collect the processed items.

The foliot crystallizer is the most basic crystallizer spirit.
\
\
It will crystallize in a very low speed.

The djinni crystallizer is faster and more efficient, doubling the speed of processing and increasing the output amount from gem ores.
\
\
They also can deconstruct amethyst and quartz blocks.

The afrit Crystallizer is more faster and efficient.
\
\
They also can re-materialize crushed blocks.

The marid crystallizer is extremely faster and efficient in gem ore multiplier.
\
\
They also can transform amethyst cluster in budding amethyst and obsidian in crying obsidian.

If you lose the book of calling, you can craft a new one.
[#](55FF55)Shift-right-click[#]() the spirit with the crafted book to assign it.
Grandpa will return at the dawn of the 3rd year.

The farmer will harvest and re-plant crops in it's working area.
 If a deposit location is set it will collect the dropped items into the specified chest.

Use the book of calling to set the work area and deposit location of the farmer.
 \
 \
 See [Books of Calling](entry://getting_started/books_of_calling) for more information.

The spirit might pause for a few minutes after clearing his work area,
   even if crops have mature since. This is a performance-saving
   measure and not a bug, he will continue on his own.
  \
  \
  Set the work area again to make him continue work immediately.

Betting is a type of trade, right? Maybe random exchanger.
\
The Gambler spirit allows you to wager some gems to receive
another random gem or a nugget, including the rare [](item://occultism:iesnium_nugget).
\
Be careful not to leave the resulting gems on the ground.
Collect them quickly because he is cunning and never stops playing...

If you lose the book of calling, you can craft a new one.
[#](55FF55)Shift-right-click[#]() the spirit with the crafted book to assign it.

The lumberjack will harvest trees in it's working area.
 If a deposit location is set it will collect the dropped
 items into the specified chest, and re-plant saplings.

Summoning the lumberjack requires a [Stable Otherworld Sapling](item://occultism:otherworld_sapling). You can obtain it by summoning an [Otherworld Sapling Trader](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_otherworld_sapling_trader).

Use the book of calling to set the work area and deposit location of the lumberjack.
 \
 \
 See [Books of Calling](entry://getting_started/books_of_calling) for more information.

The spirit might pause for a few minutes after clearing his work area,
   even if trees have regrown since. This is a performance-saving
   measure and not a bug, he will continue on his own.
  \
  \
  Set the work area again to make him continue work immediately.

If you lose the book of calling, you can craft a new one.
[#](55FF55)Shift-right-click[#]() the spirit with the crafted book to assign it.

The machine operator transfers items specified in the dimensional
 storage actuator GUI, to it's managed machine, and returns crafting
 results to the storage system. It can also be used to automatically
 empty a chest into the storage actuator.
 \
 Basically, on-demand crafting!

To use the machine operator use the book of calling to link a Storage
  Actuator, the machine and optionally a separate extract location
  (the face you click on will be extracted from!). For the machine
  you can additionally set a custom name and the insert/extract facings.

Please note that setting a new machine (or configuring it with
 the book of calling) will reset the extraction settings.
 \
 \
 For an easy start, make sure to view the short
 [Tutorial Video](https://gyazo.com/237227ba3775e143463b31bdb1b06f50)!

Use the book of calling to set the actuator, managed machine and extract locations of the machine operator.
 \
 \
 See [Books of Calling](entry://getting_started/books_of_calling) for more information.

The Otherrock Trader spirit allows to get more [](item://occultism:otherrock) than using [](item://occultism:spirit_fire).
 Thus it is especially efficient if you want to use Otherrock as a building material.

To trade, drop your offered item next to the trader,
he will pick it up and drop the exchanged item.

The Otherstone Trader spirit allows to get more [](item://occultism:otherstone) than using [](item://occultism:spirit_fire).
Thus it is especially efficient if you want to use Otherstone as a building material.

To trade, drop your offered item next to the trader,
he will pick it up and drop the exchanged item.
You don't need to break the unstable tree with a pick

Otherworld Trees grown from natural Otherworld Saplings can only be harvested
when under the effect of [#](AA00AA)Third Eye[#](). To make life easier, the Otherworld Sapling Trader
will exchange such natural saplings for a stable variant that can be harvested
by anyone, and will drop the same stable saplings when harvested.

To trade, drop your offered item next to the trader,
he will pick it up and drop the exchanged item.

Smelter spirits are summoned to do furnace, blast furnace, smoker and campfire process,
without using fuel. They will pick up appropriate items and drop the resulting into the world.
A fire particle effect and a flame sound indicate the smelter is at work.

To ease automation, try summoning a [Transporter Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items) to place items from chests
 in the smelter's inventory, and a [Janitor Spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_cleaner) to collect the processed items.

The foliot smelter is the most basic smelter spirit.
\
\
It will smelt an item at the same speed as the furnace.
The djinni smelter is faster, doubling the speed of processing.
The afrit smelter is more faster, doing the process in a tenth of the time.
The marid smelter is extremely faster, doing the process in one percent of the time.

If you lose the book of calling, you can craft a new one.
[#](55FF55)Shift-right-click[#]() the spirit with the crafted book to assign it.

The transporter is useful in that you don't need a train of hoppers
transporting stuff, and can use any inventory to take from and deposit.
\
\
To make it take from an inventory simply sneak and interact
with it's book of calling on the inventory you want.

You can also dictate which inventory it deposits to in the same way.
\
The transporter will move all items it can access from one inventory to another,
 including machines. It can also deposit into the inventories of other spirits.
 By setting the extract and insert side they can be used to automate various transport tasks.

By default the Transporter is in "Whitelist" mode and will not move anything.
Shift-click the transporter to open the config UI. You can then add items to
the filter list to make it move only those items, or set it to "Blacklist"
to move everything *except* the filtered items. You can also enter a tag in
the text field below to filter by tag.

The Transporter can also interact with the inventories of other spirits.
This is especially useful to automatically supply a [Crusher spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_crusher_t1) with items to crush,
a [Smelter spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_smelter_t1) with items to smelt or a [Crystallizer spirit](entry://summoning_rituals/summon_crystallizer_t1) with items to crystallize.

Use the book of calling to set the extract and insert location of the transporter.
 \
 \
 See [Books of Calling](entry://getting_started/books_of_calling) for more information.

The true form of this merchant will only be revealed with [#](AA00AA)Third Eye[#]() or [](item://occultism:otherworld_goggles),
 otherwise, he is identical to a common Wandering Trader,
 perhaps you have already encountered one without realizing it.
 \
 \
 The first time you interact with him, mundane sales are always shown.
 These vendors love trying to sell everything they have.
Sadly, it's not time in a bottle, a temporal pouch, or any other such device.

Time magic is limited in scope, it cannot send the magician back
         or forth in time, but rather allows to change the time of day.
         This is especially useful for rituals or other tasks requiring day
         or nighttime specifically.
        \
        \
        Time spirits will only modify the time once and then vanish.

Trade spirits pick up appropriate items and throw trade results on the ground.
The spirit is only actively exchanging items if purple particles spawn around it.
\
\
**If you do not see any particles**, ensure that you gave the proper item and amount.
Most trade spirits experience extreme essence decay and will return to [#](AA00AA)The Other Place[#]() quickly.

Weather magic is especially useful for farmers and others depending
on specific weather. Summons spirits to modify the weather.
Different types of weather modification require different spirits.
\
\
Weather spirits will only modify the weather once and then vanish.

create.ponder.analog_lever.text_1: 律呂閘刀者，乃精巧而準確之赤石力源也
create.ponder.analog_lever.text_2: 右擊之，可增其信號之力
create.ponder.analog_lever.text_3: 潛行而右擊，則復減其力
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_1: 可用行程書為駕車士指定其的
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_2: 凡有火輪車在，則較赭儀必有所應
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_3: 須知，車驛唯可以所示之方向駛入
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_4: 車驛亦可用以自行分派新之行程書
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_5: 置於車驛之行期，將自錄於到站之車上
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_6: 與手動編排不同，駕車士此時不隨身攜帶行程書
create.ponder.basin.text_1: 煉釜可容納萬物與流體，以供煉製
create.ponder.basin.text_2: 煉製既畢，釜中之物將自下側而出
create.ponder.basin.text_3: 若旁有可用之機件，則釜上將顯現流口之形
create.ponder.basin.text_5: 凡所出之物，將為下方藏器所納
create.ponder.basin.text_6: 煉釜若無流口，則其中所造之物，將留存其內
create.ponder.basin.text_7: 若產物須復為原料，則此法甚善
create.ponder.basin.text_8: 欲取之物，則須自釜中引出
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_1: 靜止之時，軸承將置其結構於最近之格線夾角
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_2: 可設使其永不復歸方塊，或僅在始發之角附近復歸
create.ponder.belt_casing.text_1: 滾帶可以黃銅機匣及安山機匣飾之
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_1: 手持機帶，右擊二機軸，即可使之相連
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_2: 若有誤選，可潛行右擊以棄之
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_3: 機帶之上，可隨處增設機軸
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_4: 凡以機帶相連之機軸，其轉速、轉向皆同
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_5: 已增之機軸，可以扳手移之
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_6: 為觀瞻計，機帶可染雜色
create.ponder.belt_directions.text_5: 四則，亦可以之水平連接垂直之機軸
create.ponder.belt_directions.text_6: 此皆可用之朝向也。機帶之長，可在二至二十步之間
create.ponder.belt_transport.text_1: 行進之機帶，可轉運諸物與生靈
create.ponder.belt_transport.text_2: 以空手右擊，可自機帶上取物
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_1: 焱靈竈能供熾熱，以助釜中煉物
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_3: 則其竈火可達更熾熱之境
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_4: 投餵之事，可假施用機或機關臂之力，使其自行
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_1: 安山漏斗惟可取一物耳。
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_2: 黃銅漏斗，一次可取物盈一疊之數
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_3: 以度盤可精定其所取之數
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_4: 置物於甄選槽，則漏斗僅轉運相合之物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_1: 黃銅甬道可用以遮蔽機帶
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_2: 黃銅甬道可用以遮蔽機帶
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_3: 黃銅甬道每處開口，皆有甄選槽
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_4: 入口之甄選，僅阻不合之物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_5: 出口之甄選，可用以依類分物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_6: 並行機帶上之黃銅甬道，將自成一組
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_7: 凡所入之物，將分派至所有相連之出口
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_8: 為此，亦可徑直置物入甬道之中
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_1: 黃銅甬道之分派法式，可以設定
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_10: 「同步入口」乃黃銅甬道之獨有設定
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_11: 唯組中每處甬道皆有物待發，諸物方可通行
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_12: 此法可保所有相關機帶，皆以同速供物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_2: 「均分」者，試將一疊之物，均分於諸可用之出口
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_3: 若有出口不能再納物，則越之
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_4: 「強制均分」則永不越過，必待其有容乃發
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_5: 「輪巡」者，保其疊之完整，周行於諸出口
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_6: 若有出口不能再納物，則越之
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_8: 「擇近」者，以距物之入口最近之出口為先
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_9: 「隨機」者，將整疊之物，隨意分派至一出口
create.ponder.cart_assembler.header: 以礦車合裝器移動結構
create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_1: 已得功力之礦車合裝器，可將所附結構，駕於過路之礦車上
create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_2: 若無赤石信號，則將過路之礦車機關，解體復歸方塊
create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_3: 以扳手擊礦車，可攜其機關至他處。
create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_1: 凡二礦車合裝器共一結構…
create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_2: 此二者，任一受力，即可造成行臺機關
create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_3: 則諸礦車之行，將如聯鉤所繫者
create.ponder.cart_assembler_modes.text_: 礦車機關將隨其礦車之行向而轉動
此箭頭所示，乃結構之正面
若合裝器已鎖其轉動，則機關之朝向永不改變
create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: 尋常軌道上之合裝器，不礙過路礦車之行進
若在動力軌或主控軌上，則礦車將滯留原地，直至得力方行
熔爐礦車將自行供力，自所附之藏器中抽取爐薪
create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_1: 手持鏈條，右擊二傳送帶，即可使之相連
create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_4: 手持扳手右擊，即可沿鏈而行
create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_5: 至路口，面向鏈條，即可隨之而行
create.ponder.chain_drive.text_1: 諸鏈輪可列隊互傳轉動
create.ponder.chain_drive.text_2: 凡如此相連之機軸，其轉向皆同
create.ponder.chain_drive.text_3: 隊列中任意一環，皆可旋轉九十度
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_1: 無功力之鏈輪變速，其行與鏈輪無異
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_2: 若得功力，則其傳至他鏈輪之速將倍增
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_3: 若得力之變速器非在源頭，則其速將折半
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_4: 此二情況，隊列中之鏈輪，其速常為得力變速器之兩倍
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_5: 若用無級信號，其倍率可於一至二之間精調
create.ponder.chute.text_1: 物井可於上下藏器之間，垂直轉運諸物
create.ponder.chute.text_3: 以機工鐵塊，可為物井造匣
create.ponder.chute.text_4: 置物井於另一井之側，則二者斜接
create.ponder.chute_upward.text_1: 橐龠置於物井之上下，可令其中諸物逆流而上
create.ponder.chute_upward.text_2: 以匠人鏡觀之，可明其內物之行向
create.ponder.chute_upward.text_3: 於其堵塞之一端，諸物須自側面存取
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_1: 發條軸承可附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_2: 凡得功力，其上結構，將應一日之時辰而旋
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_5: 右擊軸承，以啟或止其結構之動
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_6: 於時針之前，可增設第二結構
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_7: 務使二結構未以天工膠相連
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_8: 則第二結構將如分針一般轉動
create.ponder.clutch.text_1: 陰陽掣可沿直線傳遞轉動
create.ponder.clutch.text_2: 若得赤石之力，則斷其接續
create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_1: 異類齒輪相接，其力可斜傳之
create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_1: 齒輪可以黃銅機匣及安山機匣飾之
create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_2: 凡造匣之後所增之機件，皆不能與機軸相連
create.ponder.contraption_controls.text_: 動件於行進機關之上，其本用乃時刻啟用
可用機關主控，隨時啟閉之
可附於機關之上任意之處
解體之時，可變更其甄選，以指定動件之類
若於合裝之時，為赤石所啟用…
…則所指之動件，自始即為關閉之態
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_1: 無盡儲液罐可供不絕之流體
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_2: 以盛流體之物右擊之，以設定其類
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_3: 流管網路可取之不盡所置之液
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_4: 凡回流至無盡儲液罐之流體，皆將歸於虛無
create.ponder.creative_motor.header: 以無盡功力機產生旋力
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_1: 無盡功力機者，乃精巧可設之功力之源也
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_2: 其所生之速率，可於其輸入度盤上設定
create.ponder.creative_motor_mojang.head: 魔贊之秘術
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_3: 置或放入碾輪之物品皆碾碎
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_4: 君亦可自動化物之出入
create.ponder.deployer.text_1: 施用機若得旋力，即可仿遊者之行
create.ponder.deployer.text_10: 右手擊其正面，以授其物
create.ponder.deployer.text_13: 若設甄選，則唯持相合之物時，方能啟用
create.ponder.deployer.text_2: 其所用，常在身前兩步之遙
create.ponder.deployer_contraption.text_: 凡施用機隨行進之機關而動...
則於所經之處，皆將觸發其功用，所用之物，可取自機關上任意藏器
可用甄選槽以指定所取之物
create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_1: 施用機之本用，乃仿右手之擊
create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_2: 以扳手擊之，可改為仿左手之擊
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_1: 施用機若手持合用之物，則能炮製其下之物
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_2: 待用之物，可置於施用機下方之貨墩上
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_4: 則施用機將自行持物施用
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_1: 凡赤石加力之時，施用機則不行其事
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_2: 止歇之前，施用機必盡其已發之往復
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_3: 是故，可藉信脈斷絕之瞬，觸發其一輪往復
create.ponder.depot.text_2: 以右手擊之，可手置或取物
create.ponder.depot.text_3: 其用有如機帶，可供物料整製
create.ponder.display_board.text_1: 揭示榜乃告示牌之可伸縮者也
create.ponder.display_board.text_3: 可以已書之錄事板，為之賦予靜態之文
create.ponder.display_board.text_4: 亦可以示聯，賦予動態之文
create.ponder.display_board.text_5: 可以染料，為榜上各行分染其色
create.ponder.display_board.text_6: 以空手擊之，可復原各行
create.ponder.display_link.text_1: 示聯可用以使動態訊息顯於目前
create.ponder.display_link.text_3: …而後附於所欲讀取之方塊…而後附於所欲讀取之方塊
create.ponder.display_link.text_4: 啟其圖儀，以擇定所發之訊息
create.ponder.display_link.text_5: 此後，揭示榜將自示聯處接收訊息
create.ponder.display_link.text_7: 凡相合之方塊，皆供獨有之訊息
create.ponder.display_link.text_8: 一示聯可與數種不同之揭示器共用
create.ponder.display_link_redstone.head: 赤石節制
create.ponder.display_link_redstone.text: 凡赤石加力，則示聯止其更新
凡其力斷焉，其計時復原，新訊息亦將即刻發送
源頭所發之信號，不礙示聯
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_1: 雲梯機可於已標之位間，垂直移動結構
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_10: 凡在此列之赤石觸點，皆將轉化
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_11: 予以赤石一脈，可召升降臺至觸點之處
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_12: 其移動之速，悉決於雲梯機所得之旋力
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_13: 身處轎中，可以滾輪點擊主控，以擇樓層
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_14: 右擊已合裝之吊具，可使升降轎復歸為方塊
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_15: 附於升降轎之滑門，將自行啟閉
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_16: 升降轎抵達其層時，升降觸點將發信號
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_17: 此可用於抵達之時，觸發門戶或有他效
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_18: 觸點上之示聯，可示升降轎所在之樓層
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_3: 置一對赤石觸點，使其相對…
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_4: …而後以天工膠黏其一於行進之結構
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_5: 可附機關主控，以使樓層之擇選更為便利
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_7: 右擊吊具，以合裝升降臺
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_8: 靜止之觸點，此時將化為升降觸點
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_9: 升降觸點代表一層，可以設定
create.ponder.elevator_pulley_multi_rope: …則同層之他吊具亦將與此結構相連
此等無需功力，其效僅為觀瞻而已
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_1: 以空竈右擊焱靈以捕之
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_2: 抑或，可徑直自擎衍籠以捕焱靈。
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_3: 現已得諸般機械之絕佳熱源
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_4: 為觀瞻計，空置之焱靈竈，亦可以火石點燃
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_5: 以淬靈之物，可轉化其火焰
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_6: 然，若無焱靈，則不適於工業之加熱
create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_2: 覆殼之法，可藏流管，亦可定其態
create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_3: 縱毗鄰之管有變，不能致其改也
create.ponder.factory_gauge_crafting.tex: 工坊量計可為造物臺之法式，自行排布
一如往昔，連接所需之原料
凡察得可用之法式，則圖儀之中，新鍵現焉
若自行排布之法已啟，則諸箱匣可徑直解包於機造臺中
其陣必為三乘三，且諸臺須以扳手相連
長按右鍵於量計之上，以設定其的之數
此機造臺此後可為通用，供諸般持不同法式之量計所用
產物当送返已連之藏器，以成閉環
為防所入包裹散亂，宜用理包機
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_1: 自圖儀增設新接續之時…
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_2: …量計亦可接續赤石鏈與示聯
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_3: 當倉儲之量及於或逾於其的之數，則赤石鏈得其力
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_4: 於接收之式下，鏈接可止量計發送請領
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_5: 示聯可提供所連量計之情狀概覽
create.ponder.factory_gauge_recipe.heade: 以工坊量計自行運作法式
create.ponder.factory_gauge_recipe.text_: 凡量計未置於包裹之上……
指定原料所應發往之地址
可長按右鍵於量計之上，以設定所維持之的數
每當脈絡中之物，少於此數…
…則將發送新原料至所指之址
其後，產物須歸返至任一已連之藏器
綠色之接續，示其的之數已達
量計之板面可擴展，以容納更多法式之步驟
每座量計皆獨立維持其物之倉儲量
然其將轉而監看所有已連藏器之倉儲量
以所欲監看之物，右擊之
此後將示脈絡中之總量
量計可發送他物以供措置，從而補充倉儲
先以新工坊量計之形式，增設所需之原料
可自其的之圖儀，建立新接續
為觀瞻計，可以機匙改變輸入度盤之路徑
於圖儀中，審閱諸般輸入，並指定每批產物之數量
create.ponder.factory_gauge_restocker.he: 以工坊量計補充倉儲法
create.ponder.factory_gauge_restocker.te: 置放之先，右擊倉儲鏈以連接其脈絡
…則轉運脈絡將依所指之址，發送更多
工坊量計若置於封包機上，可監看其內藏器之物
以所欲監看之物，右擊之
此後將示藏器中之現有數量
量計可自轉運脈絡補充此藏器
復擊之，以啟其設定圖儀
設定所請領之物應使用之地址
此時可長按右鍵於量計之上，以設定所維持之的數
每當箱中之物，少於此數…
create.ponder.fan_direction.text_2: 風之流，其強弱與方向，悉決於輸入之旋力
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_1: 風之流若經熔岩，則化為熱風
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_2: 凡在此域中之物，皆將被熔煉
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_3: 食物擲於此，將焚為灰燼
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_4: 然，當以火設局，以行燻烤之法
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_5: 風之流若經水，則成淘洗之局
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_6: 藉此可成若干新奇之措置
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_7: 橐龠之速率，不礙措置之速，僅及其界而已
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_8: 風機之化，亦可及於貨墩、機帶之物
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_2: 以矯具右擊，可致其琉璃狀，利觀其內
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_3: 璃面流管，僅可直輸，不可通其鄰
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_4: 流管以機關唧筒輸液也
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_6: 流體連通二者，則其末端將漸次轉移其內物
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_7: 是故，管道方塊之內，實無流體存焉
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_interaction.tex: 管道脈絡之末端，可與諸般方塊相通
凡可容流體之方塊，皆可注之汲之
敞口之前，凡有源流，皆可拾取
管道亦可徑直自若干他類方塊中抽取流體
create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_1: 諸儲液罐可合併，以增其總容積
create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_4: 以矯具右擊，可開合儲液罐之璃窗，利觀其內
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_1: 儲液罐可用以納巨量流體
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_2: 管道脈絡可自任意一面，推拉流體
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_3: 其中所容之流體，可以較赭儀度量之
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_4: 然，凡俗之世中，流體不可手動存取
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_5: 可用煉釜、物渠、注機，以出入盛流體之器
create.ponder.funnel_compat.text_1: 漏斗亦可與若干他類機件相合而用
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_1: 尋常置之，則自藏器取物
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_2: 潛行置之，則存物入藏器
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_3: 置定之後，可以扳手翻轉之
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_4: 此法於諸般朝向，大抵皆同
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_5: 置於機帶之上，則其存取隨帶之行向而定
create.ponder.funnel_intro.text_1: 漏斗者，於諸藏器之間轉運貨殖之利器也
create.ponder.funnel_redstone.text_1: 赤石加力，則漏斗不行其事
create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_1: 漏斗絕不能於閉合之藏器間徑直轉運
create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_2: 若為此類用途，則以物井或巧井為佳
create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_3: 水平轉運亦然。此時當以機帶相助
create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_1: 天車行臺可駕於天車軸之上，沿軸而行
create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_2: 天車機關可移其所附之方塊
create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_1: 天車軸之接於行臺，無需用天工膠
create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_2: 行進中之天車軸，其上行臺亦然
create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_3: 是故，天車可層疊而設，以應多軸之行
create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_2: 行臺之行向，依其軸之朝向而定
create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_4: 凡其所傳之旋力，其法亦同
create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_1: 為赤石所驅之天車軸，將止其行臺之移動
create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_2: 其旋力將轉而傳至行臺之輸出機軸
create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_1: 天車軸乃天車之基石。所附之行臺將沿軸而行
create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_2: 天車機關可移動其所附之方塊
create.ponder.gearbox.text_1: 跨軸傳遞旋力，動輒顯其臃腫
create.ponder.gearbox.text_2: 齒輪匣則為此法之精巧者也
create.ponder.gearbox.text_3: 轉角之機軸，其轉向相反如鏡
create.ponder.gearbox.text_4: 凡徑直相連，其轉向將逆
create.ponder.gearshift.text_1: 變向機匣可沿直線以遞旋力
create.ponder.gearshift.text_2: 若得赤石之力，則逆其傳動之向
create.ponder.hand_crank.text_1: 遊者可以轆轤柄，手動施加旋力
create.ponder.hand_crank.text_3: 潛行長按右擊以右旋之
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_1: 以水喉吊索行流體摧取或充溢之事于開闊之地，其便利哉
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_2: 藉由功力之輸入，可節制水喉之高低
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_3: 若功力逆轉，則吊索卷收
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_4: 其另一側，則可接續管道
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_5: 所連之管道，既可供流體於水喉...
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_7: 水喉注汲之速，悉決於管道通達之量
create.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite.text_: 若將水喉吊索垂入瀚海……
則其取與，皆無損於其源。
管道可自此等吊索，無盡取與。
create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_1: 吊索盡收之時，則不能行其事
create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_3: 其澤之表，終將略低於水喉之末
create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_5: 所注之澤，其高不過水喉之末上一層
create.ponder.item_drain.header: 以物渠汲取諸物之流體
create.ponder.item_drain.text_1: 物渠可自諸物中汲取流體
create.ponder.item_drain.text_2: 右擊之，可將手中之物所盛流體，傾入其中
create.ponder.item_drain.text_5: 管道脈絡，此時可自物渠內儲中抽取流體
create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_1: 諸秘庫可合併，以增其總容積
create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_2: 然，其中之物不可手動存取
create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_3: 凡轉運物品之機件，既可存物於內…
create.ponder.large_cogwheel.text_2: 此將所傳之速率，轉至他軸
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_1: 大水車者，隨流水之勢而轉，力之源也
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_2: 使流水覆他方，弗能曾其力
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_4: ……然其功力承載，則遠高於前者
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_5: 手執木材，擊之，得更其貌
潛行且以空手右擊，則黏漿可去
機骨之黏面，能附其前直列之方物
以扳手測之，可精定其附物之距
若行合控之法，則諸相連之機骨，其距可一併而調
若欲附物於他面，則必用天工膠
循此諸法，萬物不拘其形，皆可聯為一體，成大機關而行
create.ponder.linear_chassis_group.text_: 直機骨，可與其旁同類者相連
機關動其一，則眾皆隨行
然機骨之類、之向苟異，則不相連也
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_1: 機關臂於設置之前，須先指定其出入之口
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_2: 手持機臂，右擊諸藏器，即可指定為的
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_3: 復擊之，可更易其出入（藍為入，黃為出）
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_5: 一旦置定，機關臂將尋先前所選之的而動
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_6: 在其界內，出入之口，數量不拘
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_7: 然，非所有藏器皆可直接取與
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_8: 漏斗與貨墩，可為橋樑以渡其隙
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_filtering.t: 或需以甄選之法，約束機關臂之的
機關臂本身，無甄選之能
然，若以黃銅漏斗為的，則其甄選之法，可為機關臂所知
機關臂亦有靈智，凡不能分派之物，概不拾取
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_modes.text_: 機關臂若需於數個可用之出口中擇一
可於度盤之上，為其設法
「輪巡」者，周行於諸可用之出口也
若有出口不能再納物，則越之
「強制輪巡」則永不越過，必待其有容乃發
「首選其的」者，以最早編設之出口為先
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: 凡赤石加力之時，機關臂則不行其事
止歇之前，必盡其已發之往復
是故，可藉信脈斷絕之瞬，觸發其一輪往復
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.header: 以機關軸承移動結構之法
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_1: 機關軸承可附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_2: 凡受旋力，則將其合裝為旋轉機關
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_1: 列成方陣之機造臺，可用以自行運作諸般造物法式
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_2: 以扳手，可為諸臺安排其路徑
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_3: 欲使其可用，則諸路徑須歸於一處，以為出口，方向不拘
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_4: 凡所造之物，將置於出口處之藏器內
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_5: 機造臺需得以旋力，方能運作
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_6: 右擊其正面，可手動入物
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_7: 一旦路徑中每格皆有物，則造物之程將啟
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_8: 若法式未滿佔臺陣，可以赤石信脈一瞬，強使其啟動
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter_connect: 諸物可自行置入機造臺
以機匙擊其背，可合諸臺之入口為一
此後，凡相連之機造臺，皆可由同一入口納物
部分法式，或需額外之機造臺，以填路徑之隙
以槽蓋蔽之，可使機造臺於陣列中，視為空格
以扳手於其背所造之共用入口，亦可跨越被蔽之臺
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_1: 鑽機若得旋力，則可破碎其正前方之方塊
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_2: 其開採之速，悉決於旋力之大小
create.ponder.mechanical_drill_contrapti: 凡鑽機隨行進之機關而動...
...則機關所遇之方塊，皆將為其所碎
create.ponder.mechanical_harvester.text_: 凡機關鐮隨行進之機關而動…
…則將收割沿途所有已熟之作物，並使其復歸原狀
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_1: 合用合料機與煉釜，部分造物之法可自行運作
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_2: 可用之法式，含諸般無序造物之法，並若干額外之法
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_3: 此類法式之中，部分或需焱靈竈之熾熱相助
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_4: 若兩法互擾，可用甄選槽以解之
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.header: 以機關鞴鞴移動結構之法
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_1: 機關鞴鞴可推動其前之塊方
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_2: 其行進之速與向，悉決於旋力功力之輸入
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_3: 黏性機關鞴鞴，可將其所附之方塊拖回
create.ponder.mechanical_piston_modes.te: 凡鞴鞴止歇，其所動之結構，將復歸為方塊
可設使其永不復歸，或僅於始發之位復歸
create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_1: 凡機關犁隨行進之機關而動…
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_2: 待煉之物，可擲於機榨之下，或置於其下方之貨墩上
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_4: 則機榨將自行夾持鍛壓
create.ponder.mechanical_press_compactin: 釜中所容之物，若以機榨壓之，將使其聚合
聚合之法，可用於諸般二乘二、三乘三之造物法式，亦含若干額外之法
此類法式之中，部分或需焱靈竈之熾熱相助
若兩法互擾，可用甄選槽以解之
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow.text_: 機關唧筒主掌其所連管道脈絡之流動
其上箭頭，示流動之向也
其後之脈絡，於斯時汲取流體…
…而前方之脈絡，則將其向外輸送
唧筒之方向，不受輸入旋力之轉向所動
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.head: 機關唧筒之通量
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: 機關唧筒，不論其速，其效可及十六步內之相連管道
旋力之大小，可變更流傳之速…
於共用之管道脈絡中，諸唧筒之通量可合併
create.ponder.mechanical_roller_fill.tex: 解體之時，轢機可設為他法式
「填充」之法式，可用以彌合鋪路與地貌之隙
於「直填」之式，將置簡柱直達地表
於「斜填」之式，愈向下鋪設，其層愈廣
與「清障鋪路」不同，此二法式皆不毀壞已有之方塊
create.ponder.mechanical_roller_pave.tex: 轢機可助清理軌道或路徑周圍之地貌
其本用之下，若無定式，則僅破除方塊而已
解體之時，可指定合用之鋪路物料
物料可由附於結構之箱匣供給
其破碎方塊之餘，亦將替換其下之一層
須知，凡為轢機所毀之方塊，或不掉落
轢機之於火輪車，其用尤顯，然亦可用於諸般行進之機關
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.tex: 解木機若得旋力，則可伐其正前方之樹木
欲盡伐全樹，則須斷其與地相連之最後根基
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_contraption: 凡解木機隨行進之機關而動...
...則機關所遇之樹木，皆將為其所伐
朝天之解木機，可剖解諸般物事
已剖解之物，其行向常與功力輸入之轉向相逆
解木機可與機帶串聯而用
若一物可有多種剖解之法，可用甄選槽以指定其一
若無甄選，則解木機將輪流施以諸法
create.ponder.millstone.text_1: 石碾之用，在於碾磨諸物。
create.ponder.millstone.text_2: 可以齒輪自其側面，為之供給旋力
create.ponder.millstone.text_3: 可自其頂擲入或置入諸物
create.ponder.millstone.text_4: 須臾之間，右擊取其所成之物
create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_1: 若通以紅石之能，則示其強弱之級
create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_2: 以抄簿使於熠管，則熠管示其所記
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_1: 右擊鏈機，置鼁驛於其側
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_10: 貨自循其道，達於契鼁於鏈網之上
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_14: 此亦可用於封包機，物可封而直達
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_18: 以錄事板右擊蛙埠，可錄其址
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_19: 已錄地址之錄事板，可助補全他處圖儀中之地址
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_2: 可於行囊圖儀中，為其指定地址
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_6: ...則蛙埠將置包裹於機帶之上
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_7: 包裹若無的放矢，則將原地自旋
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_8: 鏈條脈絡之上，處處皆可增設蛙埠
create.ponder.packager.text_1: 連接封包機至其所指之藏器
create.ponder.packager.text_2: 若得赤石之力，則將藏器之物，封為包裹
create.ponder.packager.text_3: 此等包裹，可如常物一般拾取轉運
create.ponder.packager.text_4: 凡所入之包裹，皆將自毀，解其內物於藏器之中
create.ponder.packager.text_6: 若包裹之物不能盡納，則封包機不收
create.ponder.packager_address.text_10: 為求緊湊，解木機可將封包之物，直接剖解於機帶之上
create.ponder.packager_address.text_11: 篩檢之外，蛙埠與郵櫃並具分遞之能
create.ponder.packager_address.text_4: 凡所封之包裹，將以牌上之文為址
create.ponder.packager_address.text_5: 包裹甄選器，依其址以導引包裹
create.ponder.piston_pole.text_1: 若無長桿相附，則機關鞴鞴不能動也
create.ponder.piston_pole.text_2: 其背後所增長桿之尺寸，定其伸展之界
create.ponder.portable_fluid_interface.t: 行進機關上之儲液罐，任何管道皆不可通
此機件可與儲液罐相通，而無需機關止步
置第二枚於一二步之隙
每當二者交錯而過，則將接續
接續之時，機關上所有之儲液罐，為其埠之靜者所代
若暫無交匯，則機關行進不輟
create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: 行進之藏器，以自動之法存取，頗為不易
此機件可與藏器相通，而無需機關止步
置第二枚於一二步之隙
每當二者交錯而過，則將接續
接續之時，機關上所有之藏器，為其埠之靜者所代
若暫無交匯，則機關行進不輟
赤石加力，將阻二埠接續
create.ponder.postbox.text_1: 右擊車驛，而後置郵驛匣於其旁
create.ponder.postbox.text_11: 郵驛匣之性，有如火輪車，雖在世外，其行不輟
create.ponder.postbox.text_2: 於行囊圖儀中，為其指定地址
create.ponder.postbox.text_6: 凡停靠之車，皆收之為貨
create.ponder.postbox.text_7: 反之，凡地址相合之包裹，皆將於此卸下
create.ponder.postbox.text_8: 隨車而至之貨，可自郵驛匣取出
create.ponder.powered_latch.text_1: 機關掣者，乃為赤石所節制之拉桿也
create.ponder.powered_latch.text_2: 凡信脈自其背而入，則機關啟
create.ponder.powered_latch.text_3: 凡信脈自其側而入，則機關閉
create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.heade: 以機關掣節制信脈之法
create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.text_: 機關掣者，赤石所節制之拉桿也
凡其背後之信號，皆可變易其啟閉之態
create.ponder.pulse_extender.header: 以續脈儀節制信脈之法
create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_4: 以度盤可設定其發脈之時長
create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_5: 所設之時長，至長可達半個時辰
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.header: 以承脈儀節制信脈之法
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_1: 承脈儀遲滯片刻，而後發一短脈
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_2: 以度盤可設定其遲滯之時長
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_3: 所設之遲滯，至長亦可達半個時辰
create.ponder.pulse_timer.header: 候脈儀輸赤石信脈之法
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_1: 候脈儀依時而動，往復發其短脈
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_2: 以度盤可設定其發脈之間隔
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_3: 若其入口得力，則將止歇復位
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_4: 右擊其基座，可反轉其信號
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_5: 此法可用於觸發無赤石信脈方動之機關
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_1: 徑向機骨者，可與同類者列隊相連
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_2: 機關動其一，則眾皆隨行
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_3: 徑向機骨之竅，可塗黏漿
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_5: 潛行並以空手右擊，則黏漿可去
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_7: …則將黏附其同層規內，所有可及之方塊
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_8: 以扳手可為此機骨精定其規
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_9: 凡黏面所不及之方塊，皆不附焉
create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_1: 赤石觸點相對，則發赤石信脈
create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_2: 縱其一隨機關而行，其法亦然
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_2: 潛行右擊，以啟閉接收之式
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_4: 接收者，可發二百五十六步內，發送者之赤石之力
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_5: 置物於二槽，可定其信道
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_6: 唯信道相合者，方能互通
create.ponder.redstone_requester.header: 以赤石請領器自行約貨
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_1: 置放之前，右擊一倉儲鏈以連接其脈絡
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_2: 有如百貨榜，赤石請領器亦可自轉運脈絡請領貨物
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_3: 右擊請領器，以啟其設定圖儀
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_4: 凡赤石脈衝一至，即依圖儀所設之序而行請領
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_5: 抑或，請領器可於置放前，預設周全
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_6: 以此物右擊守藏吏，即可就地設定約貨
create.ponder.repackager.text_1: 有時，轉運之請領，務使其合為一包而至，此乃要事
create.ponder.repackager.text_4: 否則，或有他包雜於其間
create.ponder.repackager.text_5: 若遇此事，當改包裹之向，使其入一藏器
create.ponder.repackager.text_6: 接續重整封包機，並以赤石驅之
create.ponder.repackager.text_7: 一旦散件到齊，則將合為一新包裹而出
create.ponder.repackager.text_8: 如此，凡請領之物，皆一併而至，其序井然
create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_1: 轆轤若得功力，可垂直移動方塊
create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_2: 其行進之速與向，悉決於旋力之輸入
create.ponder.rope_pulley_attachment.tex: 凡轆轤為機關所攜而行…
…則其所附之結構，亦將隨之拖曳
須知，轆轤唯靜止之時，方可移動
create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_1: 凡轆轤止歇，其所動之結構，將復歸為方塊
create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_2: 可設使其永不復歸，或僅於始發之位復歸
create.ponder.rope_pulley_multi_rope.tex: …則同層之他轆轤亦將與此結構相連
此等無需功力，其效僅為觀瞻而已
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_1: 芙蓉石燈感赤石信號而亮
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_2: 其後將持續發散赤石之力
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_4: …則啟用一燈，信號將集於其上，而他燈皆滅
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_5: 較赭儀之信號，依其與已亮之燈的距離而定
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_6: 諸燈亦可以機匙手動啟閉
易速器可將轉動自其軸心，傳至上方之巨齒輪
以其側之度盤，即可設定所傳之速
create.ponder.sail.text_2: 其與方物、及同類相接，亦不必用膠、不必憑機骨
create.ponder.sail.text_4: 以剪右擊，使其復歸為框
create.ponder.sail_frame.text_1: 帆框者，合風車之便器也
create.ponder.sail_frame.text_2: 其與方物、及同類相接，亦不必用膠、不必憑機骨
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_1: 循序機匣者，依計時之律令傳遞轉動也
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_3: 凡感赤石之脈，則依所編之序而行
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_4: 其序既盡，則靜候再感，以復其始
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_5: 以較赭儀可察其序行幾何
create.ponder.shaft.text_1: 機軸可沿直線傳遞轉動
create.ponder.shaft_casing.text_1: 機軸可以黃銅機殼及安山機殼飾之
create.ponder.shared.movement_anchors: 若欲運載巨物，則可用天工膠以輔之
create.ponder.shared.storage_on_contrapt: 附於機關之藏器，將自行拾取掉落之物
create.ponder.smart_chute.text_1: 巧井者，增設機巧之物井也
create.ponder.smart_chute.text_2: 甄選槽中之物，用於指定所取、所運之物
create.ponder.smart_chute.text_4: 赤石加力，則巧井不行其事
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_1: 巧察可用以探測諸般事象
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_2: 可探測尋常容器中之物與流體
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_3: 可用甄選槽，僅尋特定之物
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_4: 若其方塊本身合於甄選，亦將啟用
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_5: 此外，巧察可監看機帶、物井與管道
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_6: ……凡有物出入漏斗，則發信脈一瞬
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_1: 巧管可依流體之類，以節其流
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_2: 若徑直置於源頭，指定所汲取流體之類
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_3: 以盛有所欲流體之物，右擊其甄選槽
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: 若置於管道脈絡之下游，則唯相合之流體，方可續行
create.ponder.speedometer.header: 以示速儀監察旋力之情狀
create.ponder.speedometer.text_1: 示速儀所示者，乃所連機件當前之速率也
create.ponder.speedometer.text_2: 若佩工匠護目，則得以盡觀其詳
create.ponder.speedometer.text_3: 較赭儀可依示速儀之所示，發相應之赤石信脈
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_1: 注機者，可盈所呈之盛流體之器
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_2: 注機內物，不可手動存取
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_4: 待入之物，可置於注機下方之貨墩上
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_6: 凡所入之器，注機皆將自行持之以盈滿
create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_1: 凡機關軸承亦隨行進之結構而動…
create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_3: 復次，軸承將附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_4: 是故，其所附之子機關，將通體維持其正
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_1: 水火機樞可置於儲液罐之上
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_2: 以機軸擊機關核心，即可造成功力輸出之口
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_5: 其最小之設，需儲液罐四
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_6: 若得焱靈竈之助，則功力可增
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_7: 欲達高階，則需水、尺寸與熱力
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_8: 可以匠人鏡，察鍋爐當前之階級
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_9: 每增一階，即可增一機樞，使其盡展其能
create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_5: 音域凡三，扳手可輪替之
create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_6: 佩工匠護目以察汽笛之音高
create.ponder.sticker.text_1: 膠漆鎖者，為赤石所節制之附物利器也
create.ponder.sticker.text_2: 凡信脈單傳，則將變易其態
create.ponder.sticker.text_3: 若隨機關而動，則其所附之方塊亦將隨行
create.ponder.sticker.text_4: 復變其態，則方塊不再相附
create.ponder.stock_link.text_1: 倉儲鏈一經置放，即倉儲脈絡生焉
create.ponder.stock_link.text_2: 右擊一舊有之鏈，即可使二者相繫
create.ponder.stock_link.text_3: 倉儲鏈連通之封包機，可使其藏器通於脈絡
create.ponder.stock_link.text_4: 脈絡上之他機件，此刻可尋得並請領其物
create.ponder.stock_link.text_5: 一經請領，藏器中之物，方為封入
create.ponder.stock_link.text_6: 倉儲鏈之信號，其界無垠，然包裹尚需轉運
create.ponder.stock_link.text_7: 赤石全力，將止鏈之傳信
create.ponder.stock_link.text_8: 強弱不等之力，將降鏈之位次，使他者先行
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_1: 置放之前，右擊一倉儲鏈以連接其脈絡
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_10: 營造銃所需之方塊，百貨榜亦可請領
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_11: 所生成之已印錄事板，交付守藏吏
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_2: 倉儲鏈連通之封包機，可使其所連之藏器通於脈絡
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_3: 百貨榜可自此等藏器中請領貨物
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_4: 凡坐於其前之生靈或焱靈竈，皆可為守藏吏
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_5: 右擊守藏吏，以請領貨物
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_6: 約貨既交，諸物將入包裹
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_7: 自此，可將其轉運至請領之處
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_8: 以物性或名錄甄選，可為物帳增設門類
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_9: 右擊百貨榜，以啟門類編纂之圖儀
create.ponder.stock_ticker_address.heade: 百貨榜之約貨定址之法
create.ponder.stock_ticker_address.text_: 請領貨物，可於請領條陳，設定其址
篩檢之外，蛙埠與郵櫃並具分遞之能
所設之址，維附於為此請領所造之包裹
以包裹甄選器，可節制此等包裹所去
create.ponder.stressometer.header: 以功力計監察功力之情狀
create.ponder.stressometer.text_1: 功力計所示者，乃所連脈絡之功力承載也
create.ponder.stressometer.text_2: 遊者若佩匠人鏡，可自計上得更詳之情狀
create.ponder.stressometer.text_3: 較赭儀可依功力計之所示，發相應之赤石信號
create.ponder.super_glue.text_1: 天工膠能合諸方物為一體，以成機關
create.ponder.super_glue.text_2: 點其兩端，則成一膠合之域
create.ponder.super_glue.text_3: 若欲去膠，則手持其膠以拳擊之
create.ponder.super_glue.text_4: 凡方物鄰接而共一域者，皆可互為牽引
create.ponder.super_glue.text_5: 膠合之域，凡有重疊，必聯動也
create.ponder.super_glue.text_6: 懸於他物者，常無需用膠
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_10: 收付之時，所購之物，悉數囊於一包。
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_11: 所納之包，可自此運至店前。
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_12: 凡酬勞，皆將存於百貨榜
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_2: 若得轉運系統之助，亦可用以售賣貨物
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_3: 始於商鋪之藏器、一封包機及一倉儲鏈
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_4: 繫百貨榜於倉儲鏈，而後置之於商鋪
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_5: 可僱一生靈或焱靈竈為掌櫃
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_6: 以待售之物，填滿商鋪之藏器
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_7: 欲開新交易，則手持貨攤布，與掌櫃互動
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_8: 置定之後，於側面之物格中，為之定價
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_9: 他遊者可與此商鋪交易
create.ponder.tag.arm_targets.descriptio: 凡可為機關臂選定為出入之口者
create.ponder.tag.contraption_actor.desc: 凡附於行進機關之上，而顯現特殊習性之機件
create.ponder.tag.contraption_assembly.d: 用以合裝行進機關之諸般工具與機件
create.ponder.tag.creative.description: 凡俗之世中，尋常不可得之機件
create.ponder.tag.display_sources.descri: 可供諸機件或方塊，示聯可讀也
create.ponder.tag.display_targets.descri: 凡可措置並揭示示聯所傳數據之機件或方塊
create.ponder.tag.fluids.description: 凡傳輸、運用流體之機件
create.ponder.tag.high_logistics.descrip: 凡調度諸方倉儲、自行請領之機件
create.ponder.tag.movement_anchor.descri: 此類機件，可用以建造行進之機關，使其所附之結構，依諸般法式而動。
create.ponder.tag.redstone.description: 凡營造赤石機關之機件
create.ponder.tag.threshold_switch_targe: 閾關可自此等方塊，及多數盛物、盛流體之藏器，讀取其數。
create.ponder.tag.train_related.descript: 凡建造、調度火輪車機關所用之機件也
create.ponder.tag.windmill_sails.descrip: 凡合裝之時，可增益風車機關之力者。其類諸物，其效皆同。
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_1: 閾關可監察藏器之盈滿之度
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_4: 信脈方續，直至其物觸及下閾方止
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_5: 赤石信號，此後可用以節制供物，以保…
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_6: 其上下之閾，可於圖儀中變易
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_7: 可用甄選，使其僅計特定之物
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_8: 流體之儲量，亦可以此法監察之
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_9: …奇哉，亦及其繩索垂下之長短
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_1: 軌道雖在已載之域外，其用不輟
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_2: 火輪車穿行世外之域，通行無礙
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_3: 然遇車驛或示止之號令，其以停焉
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_4: 然，機鑽及車上他機關，則不行其事
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_5: 一旦近遊者，則車體復現
create.ponder.track_observer.text_1: 擇定車軌，而後置行車察於其旁
create.ponder.track_observer.text_2: 凡火輪車之經行標記者，行車察皆能知之
create.ponder.track_observer.text_3: 探械可設甄選，唯遇相合之貨，方纔觸發
create.ponder.track_placement.text_1: 此軌乃新制，專為火輪車機關所造
create.ponder.track_placement.text_2: 欲大批量鋪設軌道，可先擊一既有之軌
create.ponder.track_placement.text_3: 而後置或擇第二段軌道
create.ponder.track_placement.text_5: 接續之時，軌道力求諸彎弧長相等
create.ponder.track_placement.text_6: 接續之時，若長按疾行之鍵…
create.ponder.track_placement.text_8: 副手所持之物料，將自行鋪於軌下
create.ponder.track_portal.text_1: 軌道若緊鄰焱界界門而設…
create.ponder.track_portal.text_2: …則將試於門之另側，造一配對之軌道
create.ponder.track_portal.text_3: 火輪車行於此軌之上，則可跨界而行
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_1: 擇定車軌，而後置車驛於其旁
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_10: 凡火輪車，其上必備行車主控一具
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_11: 若增設其二，則可雙向發車
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_12: 啟車驛圖儀，以定合車之議
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_13: 火輪車之解體，唯車驛可行之，以復歸方物
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_14: 若以輿圖用於車驛，則圖上將增其處標記，並註其名
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_15: 已成之車，可以扳手遷之於近軌之上
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_2: 車驛者，軌道脈絡之要衝也
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_3: 欲造新車，啟其圖儀，轉入合車之式
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_4: 合車之時，凡有行期之車，皆不過此驛
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_5: 置軌輿機匣于軌道上，可以建轉向架
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_6: 復擊車軌，以更易輪組之式
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_8: 已成之車，若於車上箱篋中覓得燃物，其行益速
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_9: 藏於秘庫之燃物，則車不耗用之
create.ponder.train_controls.text_1: 凡火輪車機關，必備行車主控
create.ponder.train_controls.text_2: 合車既畢，右擊主控，即可駕之
create.ponder.train_controls.text_3: 加減其速，左右其向，皆憑行進之鍵
create.ponder.train_controls.text_4: 若欲，可以上下滾輪微調至速之限
create.ponder.train_controls.text_6: 火輪車之解體，唯車驛可行之，以復歸方物
create.ponder.train_controls.text_7: 已裝之氣哨，可以疾行鍵鳴之
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_1: 行程書之用，可使他人代駕火輪車
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_2: 手持此物而右擊，以啟其圖儀
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_3: 編定之後，即可將行程書付與駕車士
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_4: 凡百生靈或炎靈，坐於主控前者，皆可為駕車士
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_5: 繫繩之物，入座尤為便利
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_6: 行程書可隨時自駕車士之手取回
create.ponder.train_signal_placement.tex: 擇定車軌，而後置行車號令於其旁
號令者，所以節制非遊者所駕之車也
凡依行期之車，絕不逆向越過號令
若增設反向之號令，則另當別論
可加裝輝光管，以彰其號燈
create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.head: 號令與赤石
create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.text: 赤石之力可強令號令示止
反之，號令示止，則較赭儀亦有所應
create.ponder.train_signal_signaling.tex: 行車號令者，分軌為段也
一段之內，若有車佔，則他車不得復入
是故，每段之內，一時僅容一車
以扳手擊之，可得號令之二式
黃銅號令之後，常繼之以尋常號令
此特製號令停車，復增一則
凡入此段而不能即去者……
此法可使等候之車，暫不入繁忙之段
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_1: 閥柄可用以依精確之圭角，旋轉機件
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_2: 其圭角可於輸入度盤上設定
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_4: 潛行右擊，則逆向旋轉之
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_5: 須知，必先諭令軸承，勿使其解體
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_6: 為觀瞻計，閥柄可染雜色
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_1: 閥管者，節制流體之傳播也
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_2: 其機軸之輸入，節制流體之通過
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_3: 凡得以開啟之向施加旋力，則閥將開
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_4: 若逆轉輸入之旋力，則可復閉之
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_1: 水車者，憑流而轉，力之源也
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_2: 使流覆他方，弗能曾其力
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_3: 執木材而擊之，得更其貌
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_1: 潛行並手持飛貨墩右擊，以選定其的所在
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_10: 此後，其所彈之物，將限於此疊數。唯其上之物積至此數，方能觸發
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_11: 凡生靈、遊者，踏足其上，必觸發飛貨墩
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_2: 已置之飛貨墩，將發物至已標之位
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_3: 其的若在界內，則高低遠近不拘
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_5: 若未選定其的，則將以正前方之方塊為的
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_7: 置物於飛貨墩之上，即可觸發
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_8: 若以藏器為的，則飛貨墩必待其有容乃發
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_9: 以度盤可設定所需之疊數
以赤石節制配重飛貨墩
凡赤石加力之時，飛貨墩則不行其事
探械能察知飛貨墩啟用之時
create.ponder.weighted_ejector_tunnel.te: 飛貨墩若與黃銅甬道合用，可按定數分割疊物
其一，先設黃銅甬道為「擇近」之式，以使其側之出口為先
飛貨墩上所設之疊數，即為分割而出之數
其側出口，將出一疊合於定數之新物…
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_1: 風車轂可附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_3: 若其間有足夠之帆狀方塊，則可為風車
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_4: 右擊以啟用之，則風車轂始供旋力
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_5: 帆之多寡，定其旋轉之速率
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_6: 以度盤可設定其旋力之轉向
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_7: 可隨時右擊轂，以止其動，復編其結構
create.ponder.windmill_structure.text_1: 凡結構，苟含帆狀方塊八枚以上者，皆可為有效之風車
create.portal_track.missing: 其的所在之界門，尚未生成
create.redstone_requester.keeper_too_far: 請領器與守藏吏相去過遠
create.schedule.applied_to_train: 火輪車現依此行期而動
create.schedule.instruction.filter_edit_: 擇近處無車佔之合驛而往
create.schedule.instruction.name_edit_bo: 變易揭示榜上所示之文

create.schedule.remove_with_empty_hand: 以空手移除當前行程書

create.schematic.tool.move.description.1: 擇定籍圖，再押 [Ctrl]，並滾滑鼠，然後籍圖得动。

create.train.status.no_package_target: 載貨之中，有郵件一封，然無郵驛匣與其址相合

create.train.status.paused_for_manual: 行期暫止，以候手動駕馭

create.train_assembly.no_controls: 須置正向之行車主控一具。（莫非忘用天工膠耶？）
create.train_assembly.requires_casing: 請以車殼加於軌道，以造輪組
create.train_assembly.single_bogey_carri: 此式輪組，不能獨力承載車輿

effect.ars_elemental.enthralled.descript: Enthralled mobs won't attack the caster but defend them.
effect.ars_elemental.frozen.description: The target is frozen and can't heal, next fire damage taken is increased but dispels the effect.
effect.ars_elemental.hellfire.descriptio: The magic flames burns even nether creatures making them vulnerable to fire. It slighly decrease damage taken from earth, but let magic damage pierce through some of the armor.
effect.ars_elemental.hymn_of_order.descr: Unobtainable potion, for Admin use. Sets the punished player's mana to 1 and disables spellcasting, greatly reducing their chances to create chaos in the server.
effect.ars_elemental.life_link.descripti: Caster will split incoming damage with the target and the target will split incoming healing with the caster. Using Cut will dispel the effect on both sides.
effect.ars_elemental.mana_shield.descrip: Use mana to mitigate damage taken and add a chance to not suffer from negative effects.
effect.ars_elemental.mist.description: Similar to blindness, mist reduces the field of vision of mobs and players
effect.ars_elemental.repel.description: The target is repelled from one or more places by a magic force.
effect.ars_elemental.rust.description: Makes the entity armor rust temporarily, dropping its armor points.
effect.ars_elemental.slip_feet.descripti: Makes the entity slide as if on ice while on normal blocks, increased slipperiness on ice blocks.
effect.ars_elemental.static_charged.desc: Calls a lightning to hit the afflicted when the duration ends.
effect.ars_elemental.venom.description: The target is poisoned with a deadly venom and takes more damage from poison spores.
effect.ars_elemental.watery_grave.descri: Makes the target sink and run out of air quicker.
effect.ars_nouveau.blasting.desc: Causes the target to explode when the duration ends.
effect.ars_nouveau.bounce.desc: Causes the entity to bounce off of surfaces.
effect.ars_nouveau.glide.desc: Allows the player to glide as if wearing an Elytra.
effect.ars_nouveau.gravity.desc: Causes the entity to rapidly fall.
effect.ars_nouveau.hex.desc: Increases the damage taken potion and non-player damage.
effect.ars_nouveau.looting.desc: Increases the amount of loot dropped by mobs
effect.ars_nouveau.magic_find.desc: Causes nearby magical entities to glow.
effect.ars_nouveau.recovery.desc: Increases healing received from all sources.
effect.ars_nouveau.shielding.desc: Reduces the amount of damage taken.
effect.ars_nouveau.shocked.desc: Increases the damage taken from lightning damage.
effect.ars_nouveau.soaked.desc: Wets the target, protecting from fire and triggering effects as if under the rain.
effect.ars_nouveau.spell_damage.desc: Increases the damage dealt by spells.
effect.ars_nouveau.summoning_sickness.de: Prevents summoning for a short duration.
effect.ars_zero.zero_gravity.description: Temporarily removes gravity from the entity

effect.arsdelight.freezing_spell.desc: Spell damage also inflict freezing effect
effect.arsdelight.freezing_spell.descrip: Spell damage also inflict freezing effect
effect.arsdelight.synchronized_shield.de: When player heals, gain absorption as well

effect.arsdelight.wilden.desc: Gain max mana, mana restoration, and spell damage
effect.arsdelight.wilden.description: Gain max mana, mana restoration, and spell damage
effect.farmersdelight.nourishment.descri: 非假以復生而弗飢君也。
effect.malum.ascension.description: Eases your fall and reduces gravity after a successful Scythe Ascenison.
effect.malum.burning_fervor.description: Your tools are bolstered with radiance, increasing your mining and attack speed.
effect.malum.cancerous_growth.descriptio: You are emboldened by uncontrolled growth, increasing maximum health.
effect.malum.echoing_arcana.description: You are made wiser by uncontrolled magnification, increasing arcane resonance.
effect.malum.fiery_embrace.description: The warm embrace of fire coats your soul, mending your seared scars.
effect.malum.flowing_grasp.description: You reach out for further power, increasing your reach and item pickup distance.
effect.malum.gluttony.description: You feed on the vulnerable, increasing magic proficiency at the expense of hunger./
effect.malum.good_tides.description: Let any fish who meets my gaze learn the true meaning of fear; for I am the harbinger of death. The bane of creatures sub-aqueous, my rod is true and unwavering as I cast into the aquatic abyss. A man, scorned by this uncaring Earth, finds solace in the sea. My only friend, the worm upon my hook. Wriggling, writhing, struggling to surmount the mortal pointlessness that permeates this barren world. I am alone. I am empty. And yet, I fish.
effect.malum.grim_certainty.description: The Weight of Worlds oscillates, sealing the next strike as a critical blow.
effect.malum.howling_gale.description: The zephyr propels you forward, increasing your movement speed.
effect.malum.imminent_deliverance.descri: The Edge of Deliverance oscillates, sealing it's next strike as a critical blow.
effect.malum.oaken_might.description: Your fists and tools are reinforced with earth, increasing your strength.
effect.malum.silenced.description: You are silenced, leaving your magical capabilities neutered.
effect.malum.sky_tether.description: The heavens call for you, increasing jump height and decreasing gravity.
effect.malum.stone_ward.description: An earthen carapace surrounds your body, functioning as extra armor.
effect.malum.wicked_intent.description: You bring forth a powerful counter attack, your next scythe attack will unleash an impossible volley of cuts.
effect.sauce.contingency.desc: When a specific event triggers, it will cast the spell on the entity.
effect.sauce.rage.desc: Causes the target to attack nearby entities, even allies, and deal more melee damage.
effect.sauce.spell_crit_up.desc: Increases critical strike chance of spells.

enchantment.malum.spirit_plunder.desc: Reaps extra Spirits when shattering a soul.

farmersdelight.configuration.cuttingBoar: 每級時運增得稀有產物之機率（小數百分率）？設0.0以禁。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableComfo: 啟則玩家有養怡效時，命條上加疊滾效。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableCooki: 啟則鑊界面供配方書，似工作檯與熔爐。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableCutti: 啟則發射器可以所儲切具操前俎。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableFarme: 啟則新手或學徒農民可購本作所增作物。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableFoodE: 啟則食物物於提示框顯其食後授之效（若有）。此同施於Minecraft與本模之食。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableNouri: 啟則玩家有滋補效時，食條上加疊金框。
farmersdelight.configuration.enablePumpk: 啟則南瓜餠需使用者潛行方置為塊。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableRabbi: 啟則兔肉煲得增食性，以匹其材之費。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableRopeR: 啟則玩家潛行空手與繩交互可自下收繩。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableStack: 啟則下列任一碗裝食物物均可疊至16，似農家樂中肴。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableTomat:
懸繩上之番茄作物破時，置一繩塊。因技拙，或擾令等作，致首用「/setblock」置塊失敗。

若君在創造或令編區受阻，請禁此。常戲時薦啟。

啟則番茄藤可攀任意farmersdelight:ropes標內繩。禁則限本作所增之繩。

§l須知：此將轉其方塊為defaultTomatoVineRope中所指。§r
farmersdelight.configuration.enableVanil: 啟則可合原版作物箱裝（3x3）儲物（似夸克與熱力農業）。
啟則Minecraft湯食與燉菜食後予滋補效，似本作所增諸肴。
farmersdelight.configuration.enableWande: 啟則行商可售本作所增種及可植作物。
farmersdelight.configuration.generateFDC: 啟則戲內各箱戰利添新物，含本作之物（如繩、作物、器具等）。
啟則農家樂中作物可替村田中原作物而生。
farmersdelight.configuration.generateVil: 啟則村中可生堆肥（即有機堆肥方塊堆之構）。
farmersdelight.configuration.richSoilBoo: 沃土為上植作物施骨粉益之機率（小數百分率）。設0.0以禁。
farmersdelight.configuration.soupItemLis: 目標食物物表。其必在碼中繼BowlFoodItem類方受影響。預設為原版湯食與燉菜。

malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.a_persona: Within the 'Arcana, a page sticks out just barely. As you examine it, the writing seems different than usual- out of this world. The texts inside appear to be a show of gratitude of sorts. The names ring a bell, but not to you.

I reached out to them after seeing their work for the Arcana project, the Malum' book background art was made by them per commission. They've done an incredible job with them and I'm very happy to have their work in game :3

The Coalition of Magic is a Supporter exclusive server organized by me and Joefoxe, without everyone's voices and support of the mod, it'd be difficult to find motivation to work as much as I can now. Thank you!

Once again, no idea how we got in touch, but they showed quite an interest in Malum and offered to have one of their tracks added to the mod as a music disc. They're responsible for the Aesthetica and Arcane Elegy Music Discs :3

I remember going on quite a witch hunt to find them, scouring through the internet and asking a bunch of people. They worked on Sound Design for a few mods and so I reached out to them to commission some for Malum. The Spirit Altar, Crucible and Totems are some of their works for this project.

There's this fella on github who very routinely pushes translations to the mod for the Chinese language, figured they deserve some thanks. They go by ChuijkYahus, so if you're reading this in Chinese it's thanks to them! If you plan to do a complete translation of Malum, let me know- I hope in the future I can replace this page with a list of credits.

I'm not quite sure how we met, can't remember really. At some point, they offered to help out with Malum- most notably with the Encyclopedia Arcana, but also with a decent few bug fixes and refactors of dated systems. A large majority of the Entries are written by them :3
I love the mod's visual identity and mechanics, anytime it was in a pack I'd make sure to make the most of it. The Path of Exiles is a huge inspiration for some upcoming stuff I wanna add to Malum.

Eidolon has such a charming atmosphere, when it released I got a little scared about how similar the mod was to my concept of what I want Malum to be, and it really pushed me to innovate. Additionally, the mod's author and I exchange a myriad of cat pictures, it is a charm.
Embers and Roots were some of my favourite magic mods I've come across, I found their very approachable nature a really appealing thing for a mod to incorporate.

By far the biggest inspiration for Malum, I enjoyed the mod immensely when I was first getting into modded minecraft. I only ever tried the 1.12 version though. The way the magic system is designed and the general sense of progression is something I love.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.accelerat: Through the use of a superior conductor in Astral Weave, Accelerating Inlay simply provides a substantial bonus to the focusing speed of a Crucible without any drawbacks.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.altar_acc: While not useful for Infusion, per-se, the design of the obelisk can be used in another way as well. By socketing Brilliance instead of Hallowed Gold, the obelisk will harmonize with the Brilliance of enchanting, causing it to provide as much force of enchanting as five bookshelves do.

Spirit Infusion, as essential as it is, has grown to be tedious. Even producing a stack of simple Hex Ash takes several minutes. Using Hallowed Gold, I have found a way to accelerate it. By placing up to four hallowed obelisks nearby the altar I may increase the processing speed by one fourth with each obelisk.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.arcane_re: The Spirit Crucible has an annoying habit of breaking the tools to work with it. While a cost is to be expected, I'd rather pay it in installments. I have designed a device I call the Repair Pylon, intended to shore items up as they break down.

The Repair Pylon requires a toll of Spirit Arcana as well as a properly suited repair material for the job. When fitted with items, the Pylon will search for a nearby damaged item in any Item Pedestal, Item Stand, or Crucible. It should be theoretically possible to repair an item with $ijust/$ Arcana.. but that's only theory-crafting at the moment.

The Repair Pylon can be used for more than just an Impetus. More mundane - or even magical - tools can be repaired without costing experience, by using spirits to fuel the restoration instead of Brilliance. This still requires material to perform the repairs, of course, and restores about half of an item's durability.

Gear made of material that resonates with spirits - created from or by them - seems to be even more effectively repaired by this. Most, if not all, of the tools and armor written of in this book will be restored by three quarters of durability, rather than half.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.aura_empo: Created using a combination of Soulwood and Runewood, the Arcana Pylon excels at channeling Spirit Arcana. By supplying it with Spirits, their stored energy can be spent.

Totems are designed to avoid a constant demand for Spirits. Whenever a Rite activates, an Echo is formed, matching the Totem's Spirit Sequence in effect with little to none strain placed upon it. This works well for a passive effect, but it does limit potency significantly. The Arcana Pylon makes up for that limiting factor, allowing Totem Magic to reach it's full potency.

By utilizing Elemental Arcana, the Pylon becomes a totemic amplifier. It weaves a Rite Locus, which enhances any matching Aura Effect granted by Runes or Totems upon contact. One Spirit is enough for roughly four activations.

By utilizing Raw Arcana, the Pylon takes on a role similar to the Runewood Obelisk. Each Pylon will accelerate speed of a nearby Altar by Fifty Percent, up to Four Pylons. One Spirit is enough for roughly Sixteen Infusion Cycles.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.basic_art: Redstone is always useful, no matter your profession or goal. One needs not be an engineer to build a piston door. I now add my own contribution: spirit diodes. By imprinting the impulses of elemental spirits upon a matrix of ether-treated copper, I have created four interesting redstone devices.
