relics.description.ability.levelup.auto: Holding [%1$s] during this action will automatically level up the ability until experience or upgrade points run out.
relics.description.ability.levelup.descr: Increases the current ability level, improving its attributes.
relics.description.ability.levelup.max_l: The ability has already reached the maximum level and cannot be increased further!
relics.description.ability.levelup.title: Ability Level Up
relics.description.ability.reroll.auto: Holding [%1$s] during this action will automatically reroll attributes until the maximum possible rarity is achieved or experience points run out.
relics.description.ability.reroll.descri: Randomly rerolls the ability's attributes for better or worse values.
relics.description.ability.reroll.max_qu: The ability has already reached maximum quality, and this action will definitely worsen it. Hold [%1$s] before using to confirm that you understand the possible consequences!
relics.description.ability.reroll.title: Reroll Ability Attributes
relics.description.ability.research.rule: Move the cursor over the fog on the left, exploring the ability icon underneath and finding hidden stars.
Based on the ability icon, match the star pattern and connect them to form a constellation.
Pay attention to details: you can see particles at star positions even through the fog, and the number of dots flying around a star indicates the required number of connections.
relics.description.ability.reset.descrip: Resets the ability's level to the minimum, returning the spent upgrade points.
relics.description.ability.reset.min_lev: The ability has already reached its minimum level, so resetting is not required!
relics.description.ability.reset.title: Reset Ability Level
relics.description.architects_staff.abil: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring one charge every %2$s seconds. The maximum length of the created bridge is %3$s blocks. Holding RMB marks the first point, and releasing it marks the second, after which a bridge of conjured blocks is created between them for %4$s seconds. Each unit of bridge length consumes 1 charge.
+1 experience point for each bridge block created.
+1 experience point for each successful bridge creation.
While the relic bearer stands on the bridge, their projectile damage is increased by %6$s%%.
While the relic bearer stands on the bridge, they gain the Vanishing effect. Any interaction with the world removes them from it for %7$s seconds.
While the relic bearer stands on the bridge, the effectiveness of incoming healing is increased by %5$s%%.
Additional Projectile Damage Dealt on Bridge
relics.description.architects_staff.desc: Between two marked points, temporary masonry of conjured blocks is formed. It does not last long, but it is sturdy enough to bear the relic bearer's steps and connect a broken path.
relics.description.archmage_glove.abilit: Each cast spell has a %1$s%% chance to start a multicast chain, in which it is automatically repeated up to %2$s additional times. Repeat triggers occur sequentially after a short delay, fully reproducing the original spell effect, including its damage, targets, and behavior.
+1 experience point for each additional multicast trigger.
Each time multicast fails to trigger, increases the chance of the next trigger by %4$s%%. After a successful multicast trigger, the bonus resets.
Each additional multicast trigger has a %5$s%% chance to return %6$s%% of the spell's base cost as mana.
While a multicast chain is active and the next trigger is pending, incoming damage to the bearer is reduced by %3$s%%.
relics.description.archmage_glove.descri: A cast spell does not always vanish at once: part of its structure catches on the glove's threads and lingers within them for a brief moment. An instant later, the stored form folds back together, as if the spell had been cast once more.
relics.description.ballistarian_bracer.a: When firing any projectile, has a %1$s%% chance to launch up to %2$s additional projectiles. Each trigger increases the main projectile's damage by %3$s.
+1 experience point for each phantom damage trigger.
+1 experience point for each phantom projectile fired.
Each kill with a projectile grants the relic bearer %4$s absorption points, up to a maximum of %5$s points.

Each projectile hit has a %6$s%% chance per phantom projectile to duplicate the dealt damage onto targets within %7$s blocks. The number of additional targets is up to the number of phantom projectiles.
A target hit by a projectile is stunned for %8$s seconds for each phantom projectile.
relics.description.ballistarian_bracer.d: As soon as a projectile leaves a bowstring, palm, or enchanted staff, an arcane trail follows it, giving birth to phantom copies. They follow the main shot and increase its power, turning a single projectile into a short spectral volley.
relics.description.chef_hat.ability.sati: Killing a target has a %1$s%% chance to drop 1 meatball, identical in properties to raw beef, which can be eaten or cooked for greater nourishment.
+1 experience for each point of health restored by meatballs
Consuming meatballs restores %2$s health. Cooked meatballs restore twice as much.
relics.description.chef_hat.description: The relic adds food to the spoils. After a target is killed, a meatball may be left nearby, simple and filling, like a piece of raw meat. It can be eaten right away or cooked to get more benefit.
When used, teleports the relic bearer forward up to %1$s blocks, consuming 1 unit from an internal buffer of %2$s units. The buffer regenerates automatically by 1 unit every %3$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each teleport performed
+1 experience point for each target that lost sight of the relic bearer during teleportation
+1 experience point for each safe landing after teleportation

Using teleportation while looking at a block within reach teleports the player to that block instead of forward. If there are other blocks above the target, the remaining teleportation distance is used to find a safe location.
When teleporting, all nearby targets briefly lose sight of the player.
Landing after teleportation does not deal fall damage.
Targets that lost sight of the relic bearer during teleportation
relics.description.chorus_staff.descript: The relic handles distance crudely and simply: one swing - and the wearer vanishes from the spot, appearing ahead faster than their own step.
When damage is taken, forms a barrier around the wearer that fully intercepts incoming damage and consumes %1$s mana for each point of prevented damage. If there is not enough mana for full absorption, the barrier weakens and lets the remaining damage through.
+1 experience point for each damage absorption.
+1 experience point for each target damaged by redistribution.
Absorbed damage is redistributed among targets within a radius of %5$s blocks.
If the barrier triggers again within %3$s seconds after the previous activation, incoming damage is additionally reduced by %2$s%%, growing stronger during a continuous series of hits.
Part of the absorbed damage energy is converted into health restoration for the wearer equal to %4$s%% of the prevented damage.

The relic bearer's mana condenses into a thin protective shroud, separating the body from an enemy strike. Its flow spreads through the folds of mana-weave and extinguishes the threat before it can touch flesh. As long as the bearer has enough mana, incoming damage dissolves into the protective shroud, consuming only part of their reserve.
While holding RMB, smoothly returns the relic's bearer along the recently traveled path in time up to %1$s seconds. After the rewind ends, the ability goes on cooldown for the same amount of time the relic was used continuously without interruption.
+1 experience point for every point of health restored by the health rewind modifier
+1 experience point for every second spent in rewind mode
During the rewind, restores health to the value it had at the corresponding point along the path, but never reduces the current health.
During the rewind, the relic's bearer does not take damage.
While the ability is active, all nearby entities lose sight of the relic's bearer.
relics.description.clot_of_time.descript: The relic pulls the wearer back along the path they recently took. The body returns to where it has already been, rewinding the last moments step by step.
relics.description.cut_glass_boot.abilit: When the relic is held, it functions like a regular bucket capable of storing up to %2$s liquids with a total volume of %1$s mB. To switch the currently selected liquid, hold the relic, press Shift, and scroll the mouse wheel. When the relic is equipped, it allows movement across any liquid stored in its internal buffer. Movement speed on the liquid is halved compared to normal, but for every 1000 mB of liquid of the same type, movement speed on it increases by %3$s%%.
+1 experience point for each second spent moving across the liquid
relics.description.cut_glass_boot.descri: The relic does not always consider liquid an obstacle. It stores it within itself, then recognizes it underfoot and lets the wearer walk across the surface.
relics.description.emblem_of_assault.abi: Allows a spell to be recorded onto the relic through the scribe's table. The spell must begin with touch and contain no more than %1$s glyphs. When the relic bearer deals damage, has a %2$s%% chance to automatically activate the recorded spell, instantly applying it to the struck target.
+1 experience point for each target additionally hit by spell propagation.
+1 experience point for each point of health restored by an ability trigger.
+1 experience point for each successful recorded spell trigger.
With a %6$s%% chance, the recorded spell resonates and is reapplied up to %7$s times to other nearby targets within %8$s blocks.
Each ability trigger restores %3$s health to the relic bearer.
After the ability triggers, increases damage dealt by the relic bearer by %5$s%% for %4$s seconds.
Additional Damage Dealt Under Ability Effect
Additional Targets Hit by Spell Propagation
relics.description.emblem_of_assault.des: The recorded spell remains within an offensive circuit until the relic bearer lands a precise strike. At the instant of impact, the runes release it on their own, directing magic into the struck target before the weapon swing can finish.
relics.description.emblem_of_defense.abi: Allows a spell to be recorded onto the relic through the scribe's table. The spell must begin with touch and contain no more than %1$s glyphs. When the relic bearer takes damage, has a %2$s%% chance to automatically activate the recorded spell, instantly applying it to the attacking target.
+1 experience point for each full suppression of incoming damage.
+1 experience point for each successful recorded spell trigger.
The ability trigger completely suppresses the damage that activated it.
After a successful ability trigger, reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer by %4$s%% for %3$s seconds.
With a %5$s%% chance, the recorded spell resonates and is reapplied up to %6$s times to other nearby targets within %7$s blocks.
relics.description.emblem_of_defense.des: The recorded spell remains within a defensive circuit until the relic bearer comes under attack. At the instant of danger, the runes release it on their own, directing magic at the attacker before the owner can even register the threat.
relics.description.emblem_of_devotion.ab: Allows a spell to be recorded onto the item through the scribe's table. The spell must begin with touch and contain no more than %1$s glyphs. Periodically, once every %2$s seconds, summons an orbital sphere carrying the recorded spell. The sphere orbits the bearer and applies the spell when it collides with a target. No more than %3$s spheres can exist at the same time.
+1 experience point for each target additionally hit by propagation.
+1 experience point for each orbital sphere hit on a target.
+1 experience point for each sphere preservation trigger.
A spell trigger grants the bearer %5$s absorption points, stacking up to %6$s points.
With a %7$s%% chance, the spell resonates up to %8$s times onto nearby targets within %9$s blocks.
Each sphere hit has a %4$s%% chance not to consume the sphere.
relics.description.emblem_of_devotion.de: The recorded spell remains within a stable circuit, gradually forming into orbital spheres around the relic bearer. They circle nearby, holding the magic placed within them until they collide with a target.
When any of the bearer’s relics gains experience, all equipped relics additionally receive %1$s%% of that amount.
+1 experience point for each point of experience distributed by dispersion
The dispersion effect triggers even if the relic that gained experience has already reached its maximum level.
%3$s%% of experience gained by the player from experience orbs is distributed among all equipped relics.
Relics of the same type gain %2$s%% more experience from the dispersion effect.

The relic does not like experience settling in one place. Once it receives its share, part of the experience spreads to the others. This way, it accumulates not in a single relic, but across all equipment at once.
relics.description.flaming_bracer.abilit: Each attack has a %1$s%% chance to release a surge of magical flame: the target is paralyzed for %2$s seconds, losing the ability to move or act, and magical fire is created beneath it, dealing %3$s damage and setting it ablaze.
+1 experience point for each successful ability trigger.
+1 experience point for each attack with bonus damage.
+1 experience point for each second of healing in magical fire.
Attacks against targets standing in magical fire deal %5$s%% more damage.
Grants the relic bearer complete immunity to damage from magical fire.
While the relic bearer is inside magical fire, they restore %4$s health every second.
relics.description.flaming_bracer.descri: The heat within the ancient plates responds to the relic bearer's movements, bursting from the arm in flashes of magical flame. Fire erupts at the moment of impact, binds the struck target, and ignites directly beneath it, forcing the enemy to remain where the flames will do the most harm.
relics.description.general.cost.title: Cost
relics.description.ghostly_mantle.abilit: Grave Mist
The ability is deactivated and provides no bonuses.

While moving, leaves mist behind the relic bearer in a radius of %2$s blocks, lasting for %1$s seconds. Targets in the mist lose %3$s air per second, and the suffocation damage they receive is increased by %4$s%%.
+0.1 experience for each mist trail created
+1 experience for each second targets are exposed to the mist
Disabled
Enabled
Targets in the mist additionally receive the Tremor effect for %5$s seconds.
Mist Clouds Created
Mist Exposure Time
Frozen Gaze

For each second a target looks at the relic bearer from no more than %1$s blocks away, it gains a charge, up to a maximum of %2$s charges. Each charge reduces the damage dealt by the target to the bearer by %3$s%%. When the target is no longer looking at the relic bearer, charges gradually decay at a rate of 1 per second.
+1 experience for each charge a target gains while looking at the relic bearer
Each buffered charge increases the relic bearer's damage by %4$s%%.
Charges Applied
Bonus Damage from Charges
Damage Prevented
Spectral Escape
Once every %1$s seconds, cancels lethal damage, sending the relic bearer into spectral flight and granting immortality for %2$s seconds.
+5% experience of the current level's maximum for each death prevented
+a random amount of experience within the extra damage dealt in spectral form's vengeance mode
+1 experience for each second spent in spectral form
The creature that dealt lethal damage will take %3$s%% more damage from the relic bearer's next attack.
Deaths Prevented
Bonus Damage Dealt in Spectral Form's Vengeance Mode
Time Spent in Spectral Form
relics.description.ghostly_mantle.descri: A grave mist trails behind the bearer of this relic. Anyone who enters it begins to suffocate, and each new breath becomes harder than the last. Once an enemy meets the bearer's gaze, their strength begins to leave them. And when death is already raising its hand, the mantle briefly makes the body spectral and lets its wearer escape a cruel fate.
relics.description.glitchy_mantle.abilit: Attacks against the relic bearer have a %1$s%% chance to miss.
+1 experience point for each attack that misses the relic bearer
When an attack misses, the attacking target turns in a random direction and loses sight of the relic bearer.
The ability is deactivated and does not provide any bonuses.

Allows the relic bearer to move through the air as if across a solid surface. If the relic bearer stands still on air for longer than %1$s seconds, the surface beneath them loses stability, causing them to start falling and take %2$s%% increased fall damage until landing. While holding the sneak key, the relic bearer can drop down manually without taking fall damage.
+1 experience point for each second spent moving through the air
+1 experience point for each second spent inside blocks
Allows the relic bearer to pass through solid blocks, but for no longer than %3$s seconds. If the limit is exceeded, the relic bearer returns to the last safe point.

Every %1$s seconds, leaves behind a glitchy copy of the relic bearer that exists for %2$s seconds. When a target collides with the copy, all targets within a %4$s-block radius are stunned for %3$s seconds, after which the copy disappears.
The ability is deactivated and does not create glitchy copies.

Every %1$s seconds, leaves behind a glitchy copy of the relic bearer that exists for %2$s seconds. When a target collides with the copy, all targets within a %4$s-block radius are stunned for %3$s seconds, after which the copy disappears.
+1 experience point for each glitchy copy created
+1 experience point for each detonated glitchy copy
+1 experience point for each copy that performs an attack against a target
When the relic bearer attacks a target, their nearest copies within %5$s%% of maximum attack range repeat the same attack, ignoring the target's invulnerability time.
Copies destroyed by the relic bearer
relics.description.glitchy_mantle.descri: With this relic, the wearer seems not to fully match what others see. Strikes sometimes pass by, confusing the attacker. Torn copies remain behind, and enemies that collide with them lose themselves for a moment. Even the void beneath the wearer's feet thickens, giving them time to take the next step despite the lack of solid ground.
relics.description.glitchy_mantle.synerg: The synergy is deactivated and does not provide any bonuses.
Electric chains stretch between the relic bearer's glitchy copies, dealing %1$s damage to all targets that cross them.
relics.description.horn_of_the_wild_hunt: Summons up to %1$s invulnerable wolves that fight on the relic bearer's side. Each wolf deals %2$s damage.
Each wolf bite applies bleeding level %5$s to the target for %6$s seconds.
A target killed by a wolf has a %3$s%% chance to drop up to %4$s bones.
For each killed target, has a %7$s%% chance to summon 1 additional wolf for %8$s seconds. The total number of such wolves cannot exceed %9$s.

The horn's drawn-out call spreads through the air and sets spectral wolves, bound to the relic bearer's will, on the trail. They appear near their master, leap at their enemies, and continue tearing into prey without fear or wounds.
Increases the damage dealt by the relic bearer’s pets by %1$s%%.
+1 experience for each bone created from a fallen pet
+1 experience for each attack performed by the relic bearer’s pet
+1 experience for each point of damage absorbed by pet-based protection of the relic bearer
Pets within a radius of %2$s blocks reduce the damage taken by the relic bearer by %3$s%% for each pet, up to a maximum of 5 pets.
The relic bearer’s pets ignore target invulnerability frames.

When a pet dies, a special bone drops that can be charged by killing creatures. Each killed creature charges the bone by an amount equal to its maximum health. The cost to revive a pet is %4$s%% of its maximum health.
Increases the maximum number of equipped charms by %1$s.
relics.description.hunting_belt.descript: The relic does not empower the wearer directly. Instead, it gives its anger to the tamed beasts beside them, and their strikes become noticeably heavier. The more such companions join the fight, the worse it gets for the chosen target.
relics.description.illusionists_mantle.a: When the relic bearer takes damage, has a %1$s%% chance to create an illusion behind the attacking target, lasting %2$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced by illusions.
+1 experience point for each death prevention by exchanging with an illusion.
+1 experience point for each paralysis trigger from a destroyed illusion.
+1 experience point for each illusion created.

When fatal damage is taken, transfers the relic bearer to their nearest illusion. A new illusion appears and immediately dies at the location where the damage was received, while the chosen illusion disappears.
Reduces damage taken by the relic bearer by %4$s%% for each of their illusions within %3$s blocks.
Destroying one of the relic bearer's illusions inflicts paralysis on its linked target for %5$s seconds.
relics.description.illusionists_mantle.d: An incoming strike splits into a false image, leaving a new target beside the attacker for doubt and error. Illusions draw attention away from the relic bearer's true body, disrupting enemies' choice of target. The more such reflections are nearby, the harder it becomes for an enemy strike to find the right direction.
relics.description.jellyfish_necklace.ab: Aquatic Regeneration
Increases the relic wearer's maximum health by %1$s% and their regeneration by %2$s%, but only while they are in liquid or in the rain.
+1 experience point for every unit of health restored
Upon leaving the water, the bonus to additional maximum health is replaced with absorption hearts, which are consumed as damage is taken.
Health Restored
Electric Discharge
The ability is deactivated and provides no bonuses.

Every %1$s seconds, accumulates a charge of electric arc, with a maximum of %2$s charges. When the relic's wearer touches any living entity, 1 electric arc is consumed, and all targets within %3$s blocks are knocked back with %4$s%% force, paralyzed for %5$s seconds, and trigger a short electric chain that bounces between nearby targets within %6$s blocks up to %7$s times, dealing %8$s damage to everything in its path.
+1 experience point for each electric arc bounce
+1 experience point for each second of paralysis applied to a target by an attack
+1 experience point for each electric arc generated
Disabled
Enabled

When the ability triggers, the relic's wearer gains the ability for %10$s seconds to paralyze targets with their attacks for %5$s seconds. The paralysis only works on targets that have not already been paralyzed by this mechanic during the current ability trigger.
The electric chain's damage to targets in liquid or rain is increased by %9$s%%.
Electric Chain Bounces
Electric Chain Damage
Electric Chains Created
Paralysis Duration from Attacks
Electric Arcs Accumulated
Paralysis Duration from Electric Arc Explosions
relics.description.jellyfish_necklace.de: The relic comes alive only where there is water. In the rain or in liquid, it keeps the wearer steadier on their feet and closes their wounds. While electric arcs build up in its tentacles, it is better not to touch it: brush against it, and one of them breaks free, stinging everyone in its path.
The ability is deactivated and provides no bonuses.

While holding the jump key, reduces the relic wearer's gravity and air resistance, and increases their movement inertia by %1$s%%. Fall damage while using this ability is also reduced, but its effectiveness is inversely proportional to the vertical movement speed of the relic wearer.
+1 experience point for each second of gliding
+1 experience point for each point of blocked damage from the modifier
+1 experience point for each additional point of damage from the modifier
Using the ability before falling negates all potential fall damage and preserves momentum for the next jump.
Reduces incoming damage to the relic wearer by %3$s%% while using the ability.
While using the ability, increases projectile damage dealt by the relic wearer by %2$s%%.
Increases the maximum number of equipped charms by %1$s.
relics.description.kinetic_belt.descript: The relic does not let the wearer truly fly, but it lets them stay in the air longer. The body loses altitude more slowly, preserves momentum better, and lands more softly.
The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
While gliding for %2$s seconds, leaves a trail of electric chains behind the relic bearer, dealing %1$s damage to any target on contact.
Allows free movement within tree leaves and prevents fall damage when landing on them. The relic wearer also heals for %1$s health every second while in foliage.
+1 experience point for each unit of health restored while camouflaged in foliage
+1 experience point for each second spent in foliage
When the ability triggers, the relic wearer gains %2$s additional absorption health.
The relic bearer gains the invisibility effect for the duration of the ability, but any interaction with the world will remove it for %3$s seconds.
Health Restored While Camouflaged in Foliage

When taking fatal damage, the relic wearer is protected from death by absorbing leaves within a radius of %1$s blocks. The amount of foliage absorbed depends on the fatal damage received, with 1 block blocking up to %2$s damage.
+1 experience point for each foliage block absorbed
+1 experience point for each target hit by a leaf projectile
Leaf projectiles deal %3$s damage and paralyze all targets in their path for %4$s seconds.
relics.description.leafy_mantle.descript: With this relic, foliage parts before the wearer: among the branches, they move freely, without obstacles, and gradually restore health. And when death comes too close, the forest takes the blows upon itself.
relics.description.mana_ring.ability.res: Increases the relic bearer's maximum mana by %1$s%%.
+1 experience point for each point of mana restored through healing.
+1 experience point for each point of mana borrowed.
When the relic bearer restores health, also restores %3$s mana for each point of health restored.

Allows spells to be used when mana is insufficient by borrowing the missing amount. The borrowed portion of the cost is increased by %4$s%% and is repaid at the same rate and under the same conditions as normal mana regeneration.
Increases the relic bearer's mana regeneration speed by %2$s%%.
relics.description.mana_ring.description: The relic bearer's inner reserve expands, allowing them to hold more mana and regain lost power faster.
relics.description.midnight_mantle.abili: Taking damage has a %1$s%% chance to release a star in a random direction, which will merge with other such stars within %2$s blocks into a constellation. Crossing a constellation line applies tremor to the target for %3$s seconds, and touching a star instantly explodes it, dealing %5$s damage to all targets within %4$s blocks. Stars also explode automatically %6$s seconds after appearing.
+1 experience point for each star created
+1 experience point for each unit of damage dealt by a star
+1 experience point for each second a constellation applies tremor to a target
A star's explosion also stuns targets for %7$s seconds.

When light level is below %1$s%%, cloaks the relic wearer in shadow, granting them invisibility. Upon leaving the shadows, the ability cannot trigger again for %2$s seconds, and also not until all targets within 16 blocks lose sight of the relic wearer.
+1 experience point for each second spent invisible
+1 experience point for each attack made from invisibility
An attack from the shadows deals %3$s%% increased damage.
+a random amount of experience within the range of bonus damage dealt in Full Moon mode
+1 experience point for each additional unit of health restored in New Moon mode
Increases damage dealt by the relic wearer by %1$s%% and their attack speed by %2$s%%. The effectiveness of the bonuses depends on how close the current Moon phase is to the full moon.
Increases the relic wearer's maximum health by %3$s%% and their regeneration by %4$s%%. The effectiveness of the bonuses depends on how close the current Moon phase is to the new moon.
Switching the ability's mode for %5$s seconds increases its effectiveness by %6$s%%.

When the relic wearer deals damage, there is a %1$s%% chance to summon a falling star from the sky, which upon landing creates a shockwave with a radius of %2$s blocks, dealing %3$s%% of the originally dealt damage and stunning the target for %4$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each target hit by a star's shockwave
+1 experience point for each star bounce
+1 experience point for each star created
With a %5$s%% chance, a fallen star will bounce off the surface without being destroyed. The shockwave radius decreases by 1 for each bounce. The effect can trigger multiple times.
relics.description.midnight_mantle.descr: The relic changes with the Moon: under a full moon, the wearer strikes faster and harder, while under a new moon, they become tougher and recover from wounds more easily. In darkness, it hides them from prying eyes until light reveals their silhouette again. And if the wearer is wounded, stars flare around them, ready to form a deadly constellation.
relics.description.piglin_mask.ability.b: When trading, piglins return up to %1$s trade results for a single unit of currency.
+1 experience point for each extra unit of currency picked up by the piglin
+1 experience point for each trade with piglins
Before trading, the piglin may immediately collect up to %2$s currency units from the relic bearer.
Items received from trading with piglins
relics.description.piglin_mask.ability.l: Killing targets drops extra gold teeth. Their amount depends on the target's maximum health, and for every %2$s health points there is a %1$s%% chance to drop one tooth. Teeth can be used for piglin trading or melted into gold.
+1 experience point for each gold tooth dropped
+1 experience point for each charge gained from gold teeth

Picking up dropped teeth for %3$s seconds increases damage by %4$s%% and attack speed by %5$s%% per collected tooth. Picking up a new tooth refreshes the effect duration. When the number of collected teeth reaches 32, further pickups no longer refresh the duration but triple all bonuses until time expires.
Extra damage dealt under tooth effect
Time spent under tripled tooth effect
relics.description.piglin_mask.ability.n: Piglins no longer attack the relic bearer first.
+1 experience point each time a piglin defends the relic bearer
Nearby piglins attack anyone who tries to harm the relic bearer or has been attacked by them.
Piglins who defended the relic bearer
relics.description.piglin_mask.descripti: The relic echoes the features of piglins, spawn of the Nether, and even a stranger wearing it is not immediately taken for an enemy. In trades, they take gold as always, but give back more than they should. And if it comes to a fight, they rise to defend a familiar face.
relics.description.quantum_bubble.abilit: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring one charge every %2$s seconds. When an enemy projectile approaches the bearer, it is automatically captured in a bubble and consumes one charge.
+1 experience point for each full negation of incoming damage.
+1 experience point for each captured projectile.
Destroying a bubble releases a burst of energy that blinds all targets within %4$s blocks for %5$s seconds and causes them to lose sight of the relic bearer.
If at least one bubble with a captured projectile exists within %3$s blocks of the bearer, any incoming damage is fully canceled, after which one of the bubbles pops.
When a bubble is destroyed, intercepted projectiles are empowered and redirected toward their original owner.
relics.description.quantum_bubble.descri: Space near the relic bearer condenses into fragile bubbles, snatching incoming projectiles from their path. Anything caught inside freezes in a motionless distortion and remains there until the shell is destroyed. Even at invisible speed, the projectile never reaches its target: the bubble holds it in a frozen instant, preventing its motion from completing.
relics.description.reflective_necklace.a: When the relic's wearer takes damage, there is a %1$s%% chance to create an orb storing %2$s%% of the damage received. When the relic's wearer attacks, all nearby orbs within a radius of 16 blocks are sent in turn toward the attacked target. Upon colliding with any target in its path, the orb deals the stored damage to it and then disappears. The orb will also disappear if it collides with any solid block or if no target is chosen within %3$s seconds after it appears.
+1 experience point for every 10% of the relic wearer's maximum health as damage stored in a generated orb
+1 experience point for each hit dealt by an orb
The orb bounces up to %6$s times off solid surfaces or when moving more than 16 blocks away from the relic's wearer.
The orb no longer disappears upon hitting the first target it encounters, and instead pierces through up to %4$s targets in its path.
When dealing damage to targets, the orb also stuns them for %5$s seconds.
relics.description.reflective_necklace.d: The relic does not stop the blow from reaching the body - and that is its unpleasant honesty. It only takes part of the damage onto itself and hides it nearby, in pale spheres that linger beside the wearer. Once the wearer strikes back, the spheres obediently break away: one after another, until they shatter against an enemy, a wall, or something else.
relics.description.relic.intro.bottom_sc: Responsible for the content of the entire interface you’re currently viewing. It determines both what is shown in the top scroll and what is shown in the bottom scroll. However, in its case, the list of tabs is fixed.
relics.description.relic.intro.buttons: Each tab has a large number of buttons. Almost all of them are labeled, so just hover over them and read the description if you don’t know what they do.
relics.description.relic.intro.customiza: Here you can customize the relic to your liking! The interface may seem complicated, but it’s actually easy to understand:
relics.description.relic.intro.title: Welcome to Relics!
relics.description.relic.intro.top_scrol: Responsible for the description of what you’re currently viewing. It has tabs attached to it for switching the description category: the description itself, statistics, settings, and more. The list of tabs also changes depending on which tab of the bottom scroll you’re currently viewing.
relics.description.relic.rankup.descript: Resets all accumulated relic and ability levels, as well as any unspent ability upgrade points. In return, increases the relic's rank, which raises its maximum level and alters the behavior of certain abilities.
relics.description.relic.rankup.max_rank: The relic has already reached its maximum rank and can no longer be increased!
relics.description.relic.rankup.title: Relic Rank Up
relics.description.relic.rankup.warning: This action significantly affects the relic's state. Hold [%1$s] before using to confirm that you understand the possible consequences!
relics.description.researching.ability.i: Ability quality, similar to relic quality, is the arithmetic average of the quality of all the ability's attributes and is measured in points from 1 to 5 in steps of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric and shows how close the ability's initial random characteristics are to the ideal possible values. To increase ability quality, you must reroll its random attributes until you get a better value.
relics.description.researching.ability.t: Affects players on your own team
relics.description.researching.general.d: Click to join the Relics Discord server.
Click to open documentation for this relic.
relics.description.researching.general.l: Obtained when leveling up the relic and used to upgrade abilities.
relics.description.researching.general.p: Player experience from vanilla Minecraft. Obtained by killing mobs, mining ore, smelting items, etc.
relics.description.researching.general.r: Shows how close the relic is to its maximum potential. Determined by the quality and level of the relic and abilities.
Obtained by manually increasing the relic's rank, which resets all upgrade progress but increases its maximum level.
relics.description.researching.relic.car: To unlock this ability, you must raise the relic level to %1$s!
To unlock, you need to rank up the relic to %1$s!
Ability is ready to be unlocked! Clicks remaining: %1$s
Ability is ready to be upgraded!
To use this ability, you must complete the research!
relics.description.researching.relic.exp: Gained by using relic abilities for their intended purpose (more details can be found in the experience sources section). When maximum experience is reached, the relic level and upgrade points increase by 1, allowing you to unlock previously inaccessible abilities or improve existing ones.
relics.description.researching.relic.inf: Relic quality is the arithmetic average of the quality of all currently unlocked abilities and is measured in points from 1 to 5 in steps of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric and shows how close the item's initial random characteristics are to the ideal possible values. To increase the overall relic quality, each ability must be considered individually.
relics.description.researching.relic.opt: Show visual effects for flawless relics
Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
The ability has already been researched!
Hold [Shift] for fully automatic ability research.
relics.description.rider_flute.ability.s: Right click a tamed riding animal to place it inside the flute. Right click again to release the animal and allow it to be recalled into the flute with another right click. To completely release the animal from the flute you must right click while sneaking. The flute can store up to %1$s riding animals at the same time and you can switch between them by scrolling the mouse wheel while sneaking.
+1 experience for every point of health healed by a riding animal inside the flute
+1 experience for every automatic return of a riding animal into the flute
+1 experience for every point of damage blocked while riding a summoned mount
+1 experience for every 25 blocks traveled while riding a mount from the flute
If a released riding animal moves more than 16 blocks away from its owner it automatically returns into the flute.
Restores %2$s health per second to all riding animals stored inside the flute.
While the relic owner is riding a mount summoned from the flute both the owner and the animal gain %3$s%% resistance to incoming damage.
Riding animals placed into the flute
Damage blocked while riding a mount from the flute
Distance traveled while riding mounts from the flute
Health restored to riding animals inside the flute
Riding animals released from the flute
relics.description.rider_flute.descripti: The relic keeps mount animals nearby, even when they are out of sight. The wearer can take a tamed mount inside, release it back out, and call it again the same way. This keeps the mount close at hand at any moment, even when there is neither a stable nor reins nearby.
relics.description.ring_of_last_will.abi: When fatal damage is taken, returns the relic bearer 3 seconds back in time. The ability goes on cooldown and can only trigger again after %4$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each time rewind trigger.
+1 experience point for each successful paralysis of the target that dealt fatal damage.
+1 experience point for each empowered retaliatory attack.
The target that dealt fatal damage is paralyzed for %2$s seconds.
After the ability triggers, the relic bearer gains the Immortality effect for %3$s seconds.
The next attack against the target that dealt fatal damage deals %1$s%% more damage.
Paralysis Time of Targets That Dealt Fatal Damage
Additional Damage Dealt by Retaliatory Attacks
relics.description.ring_of_last_will.des: A fatal strike leaves a trace of a moment within the relic, one that can still be rewound. Instead of dying, the relic bearer returns a few seconds into the past, to a point where their body had not yet fallen.
relics.description.ring_of_last_will.syn: During the time rewind, leaves an illusion at the starting point that forces targets within %1$s blocks to attack only it, and grants the relic bearer the Vanishing effect for the entire rewind duration.
relics.description.ring_of_the_seven_dea: Envy

Increases damage dealt by %1$s%% for every 5 health points by which the target’s current health exceeds the relic bearer’s. If the target’s health is lower than the bearer’s, damage received increases by %2$s%%.
+1 experience for each point of damage altered due to the health difference between the target and the relic bearer
Additional damage received due to health difference
Additional damage dealt due to health difference
Gluttony
When the hunger level is above half, increases all stats of the relic bearer by %1$s%% per hunger point; when below half, decreases them by %2$s%%.
+1 experience for each hunger point restored by consumed food
Time under negative hunger modifier
Time under positive hunger modifier
Greed
Increases luck by %1$s and loot yield by %2$s, but with a %3$s%% chance destroys loot obtained by the relic bearer.
+1 experience for each mob killed
+1 experience for each fully nullified loot drop
+1 experience for each mined ore block
Loot drops nullified
Lust
Breeding animals may produce up to %1$s additional offspring, but the bred animals will die within %2$s seconds unless bred again.
+1 experience for each additional offspring
Breeding attempts made
Additional offspring produced
Pride

Increases damage dealt by the relic bearer by %1$s%% for each block of vertical advantage above the target, but also increases damage received for each block of vertical disadvantage below the target.
+1 experience per point of extra damage caused by height difference between the bearer and the target
Additional damage dealt from height difference
Additional damage received from height difference
Sloth
Standing still for %1$s seconds grants the relic bearer immortality. However, while moving, damage received increases by %2$s%% per unit of speed.
+1 experience for each entry into the state of idle immortality
Additional damage received while moving
Time spent in idle immortality
Wrath

Upon striking, a %1$s-second damage window opens: at its start, damage is increased by %2$s%% and returns to its base value by the midpoint, after which it decreases down to a penalty of %3$s%% by the end. Performing a new attack resets the window.
+1 experience for each point of damage altered within the timing window
Bonus damage dealt within timing windows
Damage reduced within timing windows
Damage windows created

The relic responds to the wearer's sins, but none of them serves as a gift. It eagerly empowers one who is higher, angrier, hungrier, richer, or more patient than their victim, but leaves a crack in every advantage. Once circumstances change, the same sin begins to work against the owner.
Attempts to remove the ring
relics.description.ring_of_thrift.abilit: Reduces the relic bearer's mana cost by %1$s%%.
+1 experience point for each spell cast that maintained accelerated mana regeneration.
+1 experience point for each spell cast without consuming mana.
+1 experience point for each point of mana returned by delayed refund.
Each consecutive spell cast increases the relic bearer's mana regeneration speed by %5$s%% for %4$s seconds per trigger. The effect stacks up to %6$s times.
%2$s%% of spent mana is returned after %3$s seconds.
When casting a spell, has a %7$s%% chance to consume no mana.
relics.description.ring_of_thrift.descri: The relic bearer's arcane flow becomes steadier, losing less power with each cast spell. Part of the spent mana does not disperse without a trace, but lingers in the conductive circuit, waiting to return a few moments later.
While running continuously, gradually increases the player's movement speed, reaching the maximum bonus of %1$s%% after 5 seconds. As movement speed increases, block slipperiness also increases.
+1 experience point for every 10 sparks created
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced through skating
+1 experience point for each second of skating
+1 experience point for each target hit by a spark
As movement speed increases, resistance to incoming damage also increases, up to %3$s%%.
While drifting, scatters sparks that deal %4$s damage and set targets on fire for %5$s seconds per unit of the relic wearer's speed at the moment they appear.
Increases step height while running by %2$s blocks.
relics.description.roller_skate.descript: With this relic, ordinary running quickly stops being ordinary. The surface slides underfoot, movement becomes sharper, and on a hard drift, sparks fly from under the wheels, cutting no worse than a sword.
relics.description.shield_of_retaliation: Holding RMB opens a parry window for %1$s seconds. Incoming damage is blocked if its source is in front of the player; damage without a source position is blocked regardless of view direction. If the shield parries nothing during the window, the next attack against the player within %3$s seconds deals %2$s% more damage. After RMB is released, a successful parry, or the window ends, the shield goes on cooldown for %4$s seconds.
+a random amount of experience up to the blocked damage
The shield blocks damage throughout the entire parry window, not just the first successful hit.

While the shield is active, projectiles flying into it freeze in front of the player and follow their gaze. Each caught projectile extends the parry window by %6$s seconds. When RMB is released or the window ends, all caught projectiles are fired from their current positions toward the target under the crosshair, dealing %5$s% more damage.
On successfully blocking damage, all targets within %7$s blocks in front of the player are stunned for %8$s seconds.
The shield demands not strength, but a flawless choice of moment. A blow met at the right instant dies before the relic's bearer, leaving the enemy with nothing.
relics.description.sphere_of_self_sacrif: On use, consumes 33% of the player's maximum health, restoring twice that amount over the next 10 seconds. Up to %1$s health restoration effects can exist simultaneously. Reusing the ability resets the duration of all active health restoration effects.
+1 experience for each point of damage reduced by health restoration effects
+1 experience for each point of damage nullified in exchange for triggering the ability
+1 experience for each activation of the ability
Reduces incoming damage by %2$s%% for each active health restoration effect.

If the number of health restoration effects has not reached the maximum and incoming damage exceeds the damage dealt by the ability, the damage is reduced to the ability's damage value, and the current number of health restoration effects is increased by 1.

While crouching, right-clicking nullifies all active health restoration effects, releasing them as homing blood projectiles at the target in front of you. Each projectile deals damage equal to the remaining amount of health its corresponding effect had yet to restore.
Damage mitigated by health restoration effects
Health restored by health restoration effects
Damage mitigated in exchange for ability activation
Damage mitigation triggers in exchange for ability activation
The relic takes health away just as willingly as it later returns it. The wearer opens access to their own blood, and what was lost slowly returns with interest.
If damage taken by the relic bearer exceeds %1$s%% of their maximum health, has a %2$s%% chance to release up to %3$s spikes in different directions. Each spike deals %4$s damage and applies Slowness III for 5 seconds.
+1 experience point for each spike burst trigger.
+1 experience point for each additional spike trigger.
+1 experience point for each spike hit.
A spike hit applies bleeding level %5$s to the target for %6$s seconds.
Triggering the ability reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer by %7$s%% for %8$s seconds.
A spike hit has a %9$s%% chance to release up to %10$s additional spikes.
relics.description.spiked_cloak.descript: A heavy blow awakens living spikes within the relic's fabric, sending them flying from the bearer in every direction. Each released shard digs into a target, wounding it and hindering its movement.
A crouch jump propels the relic wearer in the opposite direction of their gaze with %1$s%% force. Subsequent landings until coming to a full stop will bounce the relic wearer off horizontal surfaces, completely negating fall damage. To forcefully stop the ability's effect, simply hold the jump or crouch key before landing.
+1 experience point for each bounce performed
+1 experience point per radius unit of each created shockwave
+1 experience point for each target hit by a shockwave
+1 experience point for each additional point of damage dealt during jumps or bounces
Using the ability grants full invisibility until the next landing.

Crouching during landing creates a shockwave with a radius of %3$s blocks, dealing %4$s damage and stunning for %5$s seconds. Each shockwave parameter depends on the relic wearer's vertical speed at the moment of landing.
Increases damage dealt by %2$s%% for each bounce off surfaces during a single use of the ability.
Additional Damage Dealt in Jumps and Bounces
Time Spent in Jumps and Bounces
relics.description.springy_boot.descript: With this relic, a fall rarely ends with the first touch of the ground. The surface pushes the wearer back into the air, and the movement continues from bounce to bounce until it runs out on its own.
relics.description.staff_of_the_spectral: When activated, puts the bearer into a spectral state and propels them forward in the direction they are looking, allowing them to pass freely through blocks. During movement, nearby blocks are temporarily replaced with a spectral form that does not obstruct travel. The ability consumes one charge for each second of active movement and ends when charges are depleted or movement stops. The staff stores up to %1$s charges and restores one charge every %3$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each second in spectral form.
While the ability is active, the bearer gains the Immortality effect.
If the ability ends in a location where the bearer cannot safely stand, they are automatically returned to the last safe position.
While the ability is active, all entities within %2$s blocks become visible through obstacles.

The relic bearer briefly slips from the world's familiar layer, leaving the body as only an unsteady ghost of form. Whether stone, wood, or metal, an obstacle loses its density and lets the bearer pass through like a shadow through smoke.
relics.description.whirling_broom.abilit: When used, summons a broom and automatically seats the relic bearer on it. The broom moves at a speed of %1$s, cannot rise higher than %2$s blocks above the ground, has %3$s health, recovers %4$s seconds after being destroyed, and regenerates 1 health once every %5$s seconds.
While the relic bearer is riding the broom, incoming damage to them is reduced by %6$s%%.
While the relic bearer is riding the broom, any projectiles pass through them.
Holding the sprint key accelerates the broom by %7$s%% and consumes %8$s mana per second.
relics.description.whirling_broom.descri: The air beneath the broom's bristles condenses into a stable support, allowing the relic bearer to maneuver freely above the ground and stay airborne. Its height is limited, but sufficient to glide confidently over the surface, bypass obstacles, and maintain control.
relics.description.whirling_broom.synerg: The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
While flying on the broom, leaves a chain of lightning behind the relic bearer that lasts %9$s seconds and deals %10$s damage on contact.
relics.description.whirlisprig_petals.ab: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring each charge in %2$s seconds. Pressing RMB consumes 1 charge and launches the relic bearer %3$s blocks upward.
+1 experience point for each attack empowered by accumulated charges.
+1 experience point for each second of active lift.
+1 experience point for each directed use of the petals.
Each repeated use of the ability before landing accumulates 1 charge. Each charge increases the damage of the next attack by %4$s%%. All charges are reset on attack or landing.
Using the ability launches the relic bearer in the direction they are looking instead of the usual upward lift.
When the relic is held in hand, fully suppresses fall damage and grants the relic bearer's movements additional inertia.
relics.description.whirlisprig_petals.de: A light vortex of petals catches the relic bearer's movements, helping them sharply lift off the ground and maintain balance in the air.
relics.description.wing_of_the_wild_stal: Allows flight like with elytra for no more than %1$s seconds, after which the relic bearer is forced into descent.
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced while flying.
+1 experience point for each dash while flying.
+1 experience point for each attack performed while flying.
+1 experience point for each second of flight.
Double-pressing the jump key while flying performs a swift dash forward with a force of %4$s. The ability cooldown is %5$s seconds.
Reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer while flying by %2$s%%.
Attacks performed by the relic bearer while flying deal %3$s%% more damage.
The air catches the relic bearer and lets them fly briefly like with elytra. The flight quickly turns into descent, but gives enough time to reposition, escape pursuit, or strike a target from above.
The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
While flying with the wing, leaves a chain of lightning behind the relic bearer that lasts %1$s seconds and deals %2$s damage on contact.

starbunclemania.balloon.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport Mekanism chemical around. Can be dyed and used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior. Supported familiars: Starbuncle, Drygmy, Wixie.
starbunclemania.battery.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport FE energy around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.bucket.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport fluids around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.builder_hat.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to place blocks in specified spots. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.chef_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic curio for Players, Starbuncles and Wixie Familiars.
starbunclemania.degree_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic for your familiars. Supported creatures: Starbuncles, Bookwyrm (Familiar). Also allows item starbuncles to read Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_pickup_: Pickups Fluids from world and fill a tank in the hotbar or next to the turret
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_place_f: Place Fluid in world, draining from a tank in the hotbar or next to the turret
starbunclemania.miner_hat.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to mine blocks in specified spots. You can give it a tool to use, defaults to an iron pick. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.page.direction_scroll: Provides a face/direction to Starbuncle automations. When the scroll is used on a starbuncle or placed in an item frame on a block, the starbuncle will interact with the block from the specified face.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_jar: A tank made from cascading archwood logs that can hold up to 16 buckets of fluid. If used to store a potion fluid and a potion jar is placed above it, the fluid will be converted to the jar for flask/melding use.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_scroll: Provides a filter to Starbuncle fluid automations. Works like the item counterpart, used on a starbuncle or placed in an item frame on the tank.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_sourcelink: Consumes fluids to generate source. Will automatically drain from tanks below it if compatible.
starbunclemania.page.player_cosmetic: Have you ever wanted to look a bit more like a Starbuncle? Or have a cool sandy hat, horns or even a propeller? Now you can! These accessories are purely cosmetic and can be worn by players in the Head curio slot.
starbunclemania.page.robin_mask: Allows Starbuncles to round-robin items between inventories. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle will only pickup items from the ground. Each stacked starbuncle will carry maxStack/numDestInventories items, before moving to the next inventory.
starbunclemania.page.source_condenser: Condense the Source from Jars into a stable fluid. Will automatically output to tanks below it if possible.
starbunclemania.page.star_balloon: Allows Starbuncles to transport simple gasses [Mekanism]. Can be dyed if used as cosmetic, but will use the stored gas color when used for transport. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between gas tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_battery: Allows Starbuncles to transport energy. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between FE blocks.
starbunclemania.page.star_bin: Allows Starbuncles to embrace their inner raccoon and trash items. While wearing the accessory the Starbuncle will void any nearby item on the ground.
starbunclemania.page.star_bucket: Allows Starbuncles to transport fluids. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_hat: Accessories from StarbuncleMania aren't just for the worker starbuncles to enjoy, you can use them on your starbuncle familiar too! This one doesn't do anything, but is surely stylish. Shift-clicking a starby with an accessory will only set it as cosmetic, without setting the job.
starbunclemania.page.star_saddle: Allows Starbuncles to transport players. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle becomes big enough to be rideable. [Still a bit wip, might be a bit wonky]
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cook: The Wixie can now cook! Place a Wixie on a furnace to allow it to smelt and smoke items, also compatible with a cooking pot [Farmers Delight] and crucibles [EidolonRepraised] to automate them.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cut: Place a Wixie charm on a stonecutter or on a cutting board to have it use their cutting recipes for craftings.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_mixer: Place a Wixie charm on a fluid jar to convert it to a different type of cauldron. The Mixer has two internal tanks, for water and milk, to avoid using buckets in recipes. Only works for crafting table recipes, will always consume only one unit of the fluid needed.
starbunclemania.page.wyrm_degree: Allows Starbuncles to insert/extract items from a specific side with Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.robin_mask.tooltip: Tweaks the starbuncle's item transport to round-robin items between inventories, also stops pickup. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.simple_cosmetic.tooltip: Simple cosmetic for your familiars. Supported familiars: Starbuncle, Wixie, Drygmy, Bookwyrm.
starbunclemania.trash_bin.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to void the items it pickups and from linked chests. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cooking_p: Use a Wixie Charm on a Cooking Pot. With this, Wixies will use cooking pot recipes
Use a Wixie Charm on a Crucible. With this, Wixies will use Eidolon's crucible recipes
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cutting_b: Use a Wixie Charm on a Cutting Board. With this, Wixies will use cutting board recipes
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.mixer.too: Use a Wixie Charm on a Fluid Jar. With this, Wixies will use the milk and water in the side tanks for crafting recipes instead of buckets.
Use a Wixie Charm on a Furnace. With this, Wixies will use smelt and smoke recipes.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.stonecutt: Use a Wixie Charm on a Stonecutter. With this, Wixies  will use stonecutter recipes

telemetry.event.advancement_made.descrip: Understanding the context behind receiving an advancement can help us better understand and improve the progression of the game.
telemetry.event.advancement_made.title: Advancement Made
telemetry.event.game_load_times.descript: This event can help us figure out where startup performance improvements are needed by measuring the execution times of the startup phases.
telemetry.event.game_load_times.title: Game Load Times
telemetry.event.performance_metrics.desc:
Knowing the overall performance profile of Minecraft helps us tune and optimize the game for a wide range of machine specifications and operating systems. 
Game version is included to help us compare the performance profile for new versions of Minecraft.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.descrip: It’s important for us to understand how long it takes to join a world, and how that changes over time. For example, when we add new features or do larger technical changes, we need to see what impact that had on load times.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.title: World Load Times
telemetry.event.world_loaded.description:
Knowing how players play Minecraft (such as Game Mode, client or server modded, and game version) allows us to focus game updates to improve the areas that players care about most.
The World Loaded event is paired with the World Unloaded event to calculate how long the play session has lasted.
telemetry.event.world_loaded.title: World Loaded
telemetry.event.world_unloaded.descripti:
This event is paired with the World Loaded event to calculate how long the world session has lasted.
The duration (in seconds and ticks) is measured when a world session has ended (quitting to title, disconnecting from a server).

toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_chaining: Causes a spell to chain through multiple grouped targets, either similar blocks or living entities other than the caster. AOE increases target count. Pierce increases maximum jump distance between targets.
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_an: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Animal
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_bl: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Block
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_en: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_is: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a baby
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an adult
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_it: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_li: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity but not a Monster
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity but not a Player
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_mo: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_pl: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_ray: Instantaneously strikes the pointed-at target, at limited yet greater range than Touch. Mana is expended whether or not the ray hits anything. AOE increases range. Sensitive 1 lets the ray strike objects that do not block motion, such as plants or floating Magelight globes. Sensitive 2 allows the ray to strike fluids.
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_reverse_d: Reverses the direction of the spell, making it resolve as it was cast from the opposite side of the block. Especially useful with block-placing spells, as reversing the direction of pierce will point towards the caster instead of away.
